Early optimization must simultaneously learn action temporal dynamics and cross-modal alignment, which yields noisy gradients, slow convergence, and instability—especially under heterogeneous action spaces/distributions and long-tail, low-data tasks. The paper asks whether an action-only pretraining stage can provide a transferable motion prior that makes subsequent VLA alignment and policy learning easier and more stable.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core LLM pretraining paper, but it offers a clean instance of objective decoupling and modular pretraining: learn a generative prior for the “hard-to-learn-from-scratch” module first, then do conditional alignment. The most transferable idea is how a pretrained module is injected downstream via (i) head reuse (initialization), (ii) latent-space distillation as an early training scaffold, and (iii) a compact history/memory interface. Those patterns map well to multimodal foundation training where some modalities (e.g., audio/action/vision tokens) lack strong priors compared to text.
summary_en.technical_approach:
A two-stage recipe.
Stage 1 (action prior): train an encoder–decoder on unconditioned action trajectories only. The encoder compresses an action chunk into a latent embedding intended to capture macro motion semantics over time. The decoder reconstructs the chunk conditioned on the latent, trained with a flow-matching objective to model continuous, potentially multimodal action distributions.
Stage 2 (VLA training): transfer the prior into a VLA policy with three coupled mechanisms: (1) reuse the pretrained decoder as the action output head; (2) early-stage latent distillation—use the encoder’s latent from ground-truth action chunks as a structured target to quickly anchor the VLM-predicted action features, then gradually relax this constraint to allow end-to-end adaptation; (3) history compression—use the encoder to summarize past state-action trajectories into a single latent token injected into the VLM as temporal context.
Key design choice: keep Stage 1 unconditional (no vision/language) to avoid entangling alignment with motion modeling; use flow matching rather than simple regression to better represent uncertainty and multi-modality in actions.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated in a cross-embodiment joint-training setting (no environment-specific fine-tuning) over 13 tasks across two simulators (LIBERO, RoboCasa) plus real-world Franka tasks. Reported qualitative/claimed outcomes: faster convergence, higher success rates, smoother rollouts vs training VLA from scratch; larger gains on low-data long-tail tasks (notably real-robot demos); positive scaling with more action-only data in Stage 1; and substantial benefits from history integration via latent compression. The provided full-content excerpt does not include verifiable numeric tables (success rates, dataset sizes, model sizes, compute), so exact deltas cannot be quoted here.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Start with Figure 1 to internalize the two-stage pipeline and the three transfer hooks.
- In the method section, focus on (a) why the encoder latent is a good distillation target, (b) how/when the distillation constraint is annealed, and (c) how the history latent is injected (token placement, conditioning path).
- In experiments, prioritize ablations separating decoder reuse vs latent distillation vs history compression; check whether gains mainly come from the memory interface rather than the generative prior itself.
- If you care about foundation-model parallels, reinterpret Stage 1 as unconditional sequence pretraining and Stage 2 as conditional alignment, and assess what would be needed to generalize this to discrete tokenized modalities.

recommendation.zh: 动作模态先单独用流匹配预训练再跨模态对齐的思路，对做多模态统一预训练的研究员有参考，重点看§3的两阶段设计。
recommendation.en: The two-stage paradigm of flow-matching action pretraining before cross-modal alignment is informative for multimodal unified pretraining researchers, focus on §3.

paper.title: DanceOPD: On-Policy Generative Field Distillation
paper.abstract: Modern image generation demands a single model that unifies diverse capabilities, including text-to-image (T2I), local editing, and global editing. However, these capabilities are rarely naturally aligned and often conflict. For instance, editing tends to degrade T2I performance, while global and local editing interfere with each other. Consequently, effectively composing these capabilities has become a central challenge for image generation model training. To tackle this, we introduce DanceOPD,

summary.core_problem: 解决一个图像生成模型同时支持文生图、局部编辑和全局编辑时能力互相干扰的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多能力生成模型训练方法。它把不同能力看成共享 flow state space 上的多个 velocity field，并尝试用 on-policy distillation 组合这些能力。对 LLM 预训练的直接价值有限，但对“多目标、多能力、多专家信号如何合并到一个生成模型”有方法参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DanceOPD，即 on-policy generative field distillation。每个样本被路由到一个 capability field，学生模型在自己的 rollout state 上查询低噪声 student-induced state，然后用简单的 velocity MSE 学习对应专家场。该形式还能把 classifier-free guidance 这类 operator-defined field 纳入同一训练框架。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据、baseline、具体指标或提升幅度。可确认的实验目标应覆盖文生图、局部编辑和全局编辑的联合训练，但效果细节需要看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses capability interference when one image generation model is trained for text-to-image generation, local editing, and global editing.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training method for multi-capability generative models. It frames different capabilities as velocity fields in a shared flow state space and tries to compose them through on-policy distillation. Its direct value for LLM pretraining is limited, but the setup is relevant to combining heterogeneous objectives or expert signals into one generative model.
summary_en.technical_approach: DanceOPD routes each sample to one capability field, queries a low-noise student-induced state from the student's own rollout, and trains with a velocity MSE loss. The same formulation can absorb operator-defined fields such as classifier-free guidance.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model size, training data, baselines, metrics, or improvement numbers. The evaluated setting appears to cover joint text-to-image generation, local editing, and global editing, but the empirical strength needs to be checked in the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法定义即可；on-policy field distillation 对统一生成目标有参考，但没有语言建模证据，别过度外推。
recommendation.en: Read only the method formulation; on-policy field distillation is a useful analogy for unified generative objectives, but there is no LM evidence.

paper.title: The Geometry Behind Diffusion and Flow Matching: Gradient Flows and Geodesics in Wasserstein Space
paper.abstract: The space $\mathcal{P}_2(\mathbb{R}^d$) of probability measures with finite second moment carries a natural geometry: the quadratic Wasserstein distance W_2 makes it a complete metric space and, following Otto, a (formal) Riemannian manifold whose geodesics are the optimal-transport interpolations. On this manifold, the gradient flow of the free energy F(rho) = KL(rho || π) is exactly the Fokker-Planck equation, and its implicit-Euler discretization is the JKO scheme. This is the geometry underl

summary.core_problem: 用 Wasserstein 空间的几何语言统一解释 diffusion model 与 flow matching 的生成机制。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏理论统一与概念澄清。它把 DDPM、DDIM、NCSN/SMLD、Energy Matching 和 Flow Matching 放到同一个最优传输/梯度流框架下，对研究 diffusion LM、flow-based LM 或跨模态统一生成目标有一定帮助。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从二阶矩有限的概率测度空间出发，使用 W2 距离、Otto 几何、KL 自由能梯度流、Fokker-Planck 方程、JKO 隐式 Euler 离散和 Benamou-Brenier 动作最小化来解释扩散去噪与 flow matching。核心不是提出新模型，而是给出现有生成模型训练目标之间的几何等价关系。
summary.experiments: 摘要未显示实证实验或模型规模信息，主要是数学推导和理论整合；没有报告训练数据、参数量或 benchmark 提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper explains diffusion models and flow matching through a unified geometric view in Wasserstein space.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a theoretical unification rather than a new training recipe. It may help researchers working on diffusion language models, flow-based language modeling, or unified multimodal generative objectives reason about apparently different objectives under one variational framework.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper uses the W2 geometry of probability measures, Otto calculus, KL free-energy gradient flows, the Fokker-Planck equation, the JKO implicit Euler scheme, and the Benamou-Brenier minimum-action formulation to connect denoising diffusion and flow matching. The contribution is conceptual consolidation, not a new architecture.
summary_en.experiments: No empirical setup is visible from the abstract. The work appears to be mathematical and expository, with no reported model sizes, datasets, baselines, or benchmark gains.

recommendation.zh: 做 diffusion/flow LM 可扫一眼几何映射；不是新 recipe，别把理论等价误读成训练等价。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick read for diffusion or flow LM work; it is a geometric map, not evidence that the training recipes are interchangeable.

paper.title: Information-Theoretic Classifier-Free Guidance with Adaptive Schedule Optimization
paper.abstract: Diffusion models have achieved strong performance in image, text-to-image, and video generation, where conditional generation is often controlled by classifier-free guidance (CFG). CFG improves condition consistency by increasing a guidance weight, but stronger guidance typically reduces diversity and distributional coverage. It remains unclear how this consistency-coverage trade-off should be controlled across the reverse trajectory, since the distribution induced by CFG is not simply the fixed

summary.core_problem: 扩散模型的无分类器引导（CFG）通常采用全局固定引导权重，无法在整个反向生成轨迹上最优平衡条件一致性与样本多样性，且缺少逐时间步引导调度的principled优化框架
summary.importance: 提出信息论视角的CFG自适应调度优化框架，实现轨迹级别的一致性-多样性权衡最优控制，为扩散模型引导采样设计提供新的理论视角
summary.technical_approach: 以去噪端点的干净数据分布作为参考，显式定义期望的一致性-多样性权衡目标，将引导采样轨迹诱导的分布向参考分布优化；推导无需显式密度估计的轨迹级目标估计子，仅需样本和分数模型输出即可计算梯度，自适应优化每个时间步的引导权重
summary.experiments: 在ImageNet类别条件图像生成任务上验证，相比固定权重CFG基线，在相同FID下提升了条件分类准确率，或在相同一致性水平下提升了生成样本的多样性与分布覆盖率

summary_en.core_problem: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) in diffusion models typically uses a fixed global guidance weight, which cannot optimally balance conditional consistency and sample diversity across the full reverse trajectory, and lacks a principled framework for per-timestep guidance schedule optimization.
summary_en.importance: This work proposes an information-theoretic framework for adaptive CFG schedule optimization, achieving trajectory-level optimal tradeoff between consistency and diversity, and provides a new theoretical perspective for guided diffusion sampling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The clean endpoint data distribution is used as reference to define the desired consistency-diversity tradeoff, and the distribution induced by guided sampling is optimized toward this reference; trajectory-level objective estimators are derived that avoid explicit density estimation, using only samples and score outputs to compute gradients for adaptive per-timestep weight optimization.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on ImageNet class-conditional image generation, the method improves conditional classification accuracy at equal FID, or improves diversity and coverage at equal consistency, compared to fixed-weight CFG baselines.

recommendation.zh: 信息论框架下的扩散CFG自适应调度工作，仅在ImageNet图像生成上验证，做离散文本扩散的研究者扫一眼摘要即可，无需跟进细节
recommendation.en: Information-theoretic adaptive CFG schedule for diffusion, validated only on ImageNet; skip details unless you actively work on discrete diffusion LMs.

paper.title: B[FM]$^2$: Brain Foundation Model via Flow Matching with SplitUNet
paper.abstract: EEG foundation models can learn generalizable representations from large-scale EEG corpora to enable single-backbone transfer across diverse clinical and brain-computer interface tasks. Existing models typically discretize the continuous multi-channel EEG waveform into patches or codebook tokens and train a transformer with masked self-supervision. Recognizing that this discretization fragments continuous brain rhythms and obscures fine-grained temporal dynamics, we present B[FM]$^2$(Brain Found

summary.core_problem: 论文试图解决 EEG foundation model 中离散 patch 或 codebook token 会切碎连续脑电节律、损失细粒度时序动态的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是把连续时间 flow matching 用于原始 EEG 信号预训练，并提出适配 EEG 时间轴与电极轴不对称性的 SplitUNet。对 LLM 预训练不是直接贡献，但对“连续信号是否一定要先 tokenization”这个问题有旁证意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法不做 patch、tokenizer 或 masked reconstruction，而是在原始多通道 EEG 上做连续时间 flow matching。针对 EEG 的时间点密集且强自相关、电极数少且有空间位置的结构，设计 SplitUNet 分别处理时间与电极维度。
summary.experiments: 摘要称目标是跨临床和脑机接口任务的单 backbone 迁移，但未给出预训练语料规模、模型参数量、具体下游任务、baseline 名称或量化提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Ila Fiete 和 Paul Pu Liang，分别在计算神经科学与多模态机器学习方向有代表性工作；具体机构信息未从摘要中给出。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the concern that EEG foundation models based on patches or codebook tokens fragment continuous brain rhythms and lose fine-grained temporal dynamics.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a raw-signal EEG pretraining approach based on continuous-time flow matching, together with a SplitUNet architecture for the asymmetric time-electrode structure. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but it is relevant as evidence against mandatory tokenization for continuous signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: Instead of patching, tokenizing, or masking EEG sequences, the model performs continuous-time flow matching directly on multi-channel raw EEG. SplitUNet is designed around dense autocorrelated temporal samples and a much shorter electrode axis with spatial structure.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract positions the model for transfer across clinical and brain-computer-interface tasks, but it does not specify corpus size, parameter count, downstream tasks, baseline names, or quantitative gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Ila Fiete and Paul Pu Liang, known for work in computational neuroscience and multimodal machine learning; affiliations are not stated in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只看架构动机即可：它给连续模态预训练提供一个“不先离散化”的弱信号，但 EEG 证据不能直接外推到 LLM。
recommendation.en: Read only the architectural motivation: it is a weak signal for raw continuous-modality pretraining, not evidence that transfers directly to LLMs.

paper.title: Variance-Tilted Diffusion Models for Diverse Sampling
paper.abstract: Diffusion models are typically sampled independently, even when the downstream objective is to obtain a diverse set of candidates. We introduce a variance-weighted batch distribution that favours collections of samples with large empirical spread after a prescribed linear feature map. The target is specified explicitly, and the sampler is derived as the corresponding Doob $h$-transform of independent diffusion dynamics. The resulting correction has a compact form: an interaction term that repels

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散模型独立采样难以产出多样性候选集的问题，构造可解释的批量多样化采样器。
summary.importance: 属于采样策略的方法创新，首次通过Doob h变换将指定特征方差的批量分布目标严格融入扩散动力学。
summary.technical_approach: 定义方差加权批量分布作为目标，通过独立扩散过程的Doob h变换推导修正项，得到包含互斥相互作用项与曲率项的粒子交互采样器，避免启发式漂移。
summary.experiments: 理论推导为主，配合低维与标准生成任务演示采样多样性与目标分布一致性；未与大规模LLM/图像扩散SOTA直接对比。

summary_en.core_problem: Design a principled diffusion sampler that produces a diverse batch of samples under a prescribed linear feature map, rather than sampling independently.
summary_en.importance: A sampling-method innovation that rigorously encodes a batch-diversity objective into diffusion dynamics via the Doob h-transform, instead of heuristic repulsion.
summary_en.technical_approach: Specify a variance-weighted batch distribution as target; derive the sampler as the Doob h-transform of independent diffusion dynamics; obtain an interacting-particle update with a repulsion term between denoised means and a curvature term steering toward higher feature-variance regions.
summary_en.experiments: Theory-heavy; validated on low-dimensional and standard generative benchmarks to demonstrate improved diversity and target alignment; no direct comparison against large-scale LLMs or image-diffusion SOTA systems.

recommendation.zh: 扩散采样层面的小创新，若在做文本扩散或多样化解码可速览推导部分，否则不必深读。
recommendation.en: A modest sampling-level innovation on diffusion; only worth skimming the derivation if you work on diffusion LM or diverse decoding.

paper.title: Curvature-Adaptive Consistency Flow Matching: Autonomous Trajectory Optimization via Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Consistency distillation has significantly accelerated the inference of diffusion models. In this work, we reveal an intriguing asymmetry: while Logit-Normal sampling priors are highly efficacious for standard iterative generation, consistency distillation exhibits a distinctly different difficulty profile (e.g., U-shaped). We identify that the primary optimization bottlenecks reside at the boundary stages (initialization or final refinement) rather than the intermediate steps. To address the li

summary.core_problem: 解决 diffusion / flow matching 模型做 consistency distillation 时，采样时间步或轨迹课程难以手工设定的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献点在于把 diffusion distillation 的时间步选择从静态先验改成动态决策。它不是 LLM 预训练工作，但对研究 flow / diffusion 生成模型的训练信号分配有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Curvature-Adaptive Consistency Flow Matching，将 distillation 过程建模为动态决策过程，用轻量级强化学习 agent 主动探索 Probability Flow ODE 轨迹，并自动构造偏向关键区域的训练 curriculum；同时引入 Flow Distribution Matching Distillation 来改进蒸馏目标。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集和数值结果。主要实验结论是：Logit-Normal sampling prior 在标准迭代生成中有效，但在 consistency distillation 中呈现不同难度分布；瓶颈更多出现在初始化或最终细化等边界阶段。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to choose sampling stages or trajectory curricula for consistency distillation in diffusion and flow-matching models.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is to replace a static time-sampling prior with an adaptive decision process. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to training-signal allocation in flow or diffusion generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Curvature-Adaptive Consistency Flow Matching formulates distillation as a dynamic decision process. A lightweight reinforcement-learning agent probes Probability Flow ODE trajectories and builds an efficiency-oriented curriculum that emphasizes critical regions; the method also introduces Flow Distribution Matching Distillation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, or exact numbers. The main reported finding is that Logit-Normal sampling works well for standard iterative generation but shows a different difficulty profile under consistency distillation, with bottlenecks concentrated near boundary stages such as initialization and final refinement.

recommendation.zh: 只看动机和难度曲线即可；RL 调度 ODE 轨迹有意思，但离语言建模还远，先当 diffusion distillation 的弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the motivation and difficulty profile; RL-based ODE scheduling is interesting, but it remains a weak signal for language-model pretraining.

paper.title: The FID Lottery: Quantifying Hidden Randomness in Generative-Model Evaluation
paper.abstract: The Frechet Inception Distance (FID) is the de facto arbiter of image generation, yet most papers report just a single number from a single trained model using a single sampling seed. How reproducible is that number if we retrain the model, or merely resample from it? In this paper, we treat FID as a random variable on a two-axis panel of training and generation seeds, and measure its variance directly on several hundred SiT networks trained on class-conditional ImageNet 256x256. We report surpr

summary.core_problem: 量化图像生成模型评测中 FID 分数的隐藏随机性，区分训练随机种子和采样随机种子对最终指标的影响。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测可靠性分析。它不直接研究 LLM，但对大模型评测有可迁移的警示：单次训练、单个采样 seed、单个指标数字可能低估实验不确定性，尤其在昂贵预训练或生成模型比较中容易产生错误排序。
summary.technical_approach: 将 FID 视为由两类随机源共同决定的随机变量：训练 seed 和生成 seed。作者在 class-conditional ImageNet 256×256 上训练数百个 SiT 网络，构造训练 seed × 生成 seed 的面板，直接测量 FID 方差，并进一步分解随机初始化、数据顺序和 flow-matching 每步高斯噪声等因素的贡献。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖数百个 SiT 模型。主要发现包括：换训练 seed 对 FID 的移动量是固定模型重采样的 3.2 倍；该差距由初始化、数据顺序和 flow-matching loss 中的逐步高斯噪声共同驱动；增加计算量或模型规模并未明显收窄波动，FID 的变异系数大致维持在 1-2%；按 cell 调 classifier-free guidance 可显著降低部分波动。
summary.authors_note: Alexei A. Efros 是计算机视觉领域知名研究者；该工作延续了其团队对视觉生成模型评测可靠性的关注。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper quantifies hidden randomness in FID-based evaluation of image generators, separating the effects of training seeds from sampling seeds.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-reliability study rather than an LLM paper. Its main transferable lesson is that a single trained model, a single sampling seed, and a single reported metric can materially understate uncertainty, which is also relevant to expensive pretraining and generative-model comparisons.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors treat FID as a random variable over a two-axis panel of training seeds and generation seeds. They train several hundred SiT models on class-conditional ImageNet 256×256, measure the resulting FID variance directly, and decompose the contribution of random initialization, data ordering, and per-step Gaussian noise in the flow-matching loss.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses several hundred SiT networks. Key findings are that changing the training seed moves FID 3.2× more than resampling from a fixed network; the gap is driven by initialization, data order, and flow-matching noise; increasing compute or model size barely reduces the spread, with FID coefficient of variation staying around 1-2%; and per-cell classifier-free guidance tuning can reduce part of the variance.
summary_en.authors_note: Alexei A. Efros is a well-known computer vision researcher; the work fits a broader line of careful analysis of visual generative-model evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 只看方差分解和 3.2× 结论即可；图像 FID 场景，但对 LLM 单 seed 排榜同样是一个干净的反例。
recommendation.en: Read only the variance decomposition and the 3.2× result; it is an image-FID study, but a clean warning against single-seed ranking in LLM work.

paper.title: CrossFlow: One-Step Generation Across Latent and Pixel Spaces
paper.abstract: Most diffusion and flow-matching generators define the prior, probability path, and prediction target in the same representation space. Latent diffusion improves efficiency by moving this path into an autoencoder latent space, but the final sample is still produced by a separately trained decoder. This separation creates a mismatch: the generator is optimized for latent-space prediction, while final quality depends on how the decoder handles generated latents that may differ from clean encoder o

summary.core_problem: 现有潜扩散/流匹配模型的先验、概率路径与预测目标均在同一表示空间，导致生成器在latent空间优化但最终质量依赖独立训练的decoder，存在latent分布与decoder训练分布不匹配的瓶颈
summary.importance: 流匹配建模范式创新，首次提出将流匹配的训练路径与预测目标解耦到不同表示空间，单模型可同时实现一步latent-to-pixel生成与潜扩散decoder的即插即用替换
summary.technical_approach: 提出CrossFlow跨空间流公式，采用无速度的一步训练目标：训练轨迹定义在latent空间（复用潜扩散的latent路径），但监督信号直接是pixel空间的图像而非latent位移，无需单独的decoder模块
summary.experiments: 在256×256 ImageNet-1k类条件生成任务上验证方法可行性，摘要未披露完整模型参数量、训练计算量及与主流一步生成方法的全面量化对比结果
summary.authors_note: 北京大学人工智能研究院、复旦大学等机构；作者张牧涵（Muhan Zhang）是图学习与生成模型领域知名青年学者，薄列峰（Liefeng Bo）为前阿里达摩院资深研究员，有多年生成模型研究经验

summary_en.core_problem: Existing latent diffusion/flow matching models define prior, probability path, and prediction target in the same representation space, causing a distribution mismatch between the latent-space-optimized generator and the separately trained decoder that determines final sample quality.
summary_en.importance: Paradigm innovation in flow matching formulation: first decouples flow matching training paths and prediction targets into distinct representation spaces, enabling both one-step latent-to-pixel generation and drop-in decoder replacement for latent diffusion pipelines with a single model.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes CrossFlow, a cross-space flow formulation with a velocity-free one-step objective: training trajectories are defined in latent space (reusing latent diffusion's latent paths), but supervision is directly applied on pixel-space images instead of latent displacements, eliminating the need for a separate decoder module.
summary_en.experiments: Validates feasibility on class-conditional ImageNet-1k 256×256 generation; full parameter counts, training compute budgets, and comprehensive quantitative comparisons with mainstream one-step generation methods are not disclosed in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliated with Peking University Institute for Artificial Intelligence, Fudan University, etc. Muhan Zhang is a well-known young researcher in graph learning and generative models; Liefeng Bo is a former senior researcher at Alibaba Damo Academy with extensive generative modeling experience.

recommendation.zh: 流匹配训练路径与预测目标解耦的思路可迁移到文本Flow LM或多模态统一生成，只看方法部分§3即可
recommendation.en: The decoupling of flow matching training path and prediction target is transferable to text flow LMs or unified multimodal generation; only read §3 for the core formulation.

institutions: Institute for Artificial Intelligence, Peking University

paper.title: Flow Map Denoisers: Traversing the Distortion-Perception Plane for Inverse Problems
paper.abstract: Image restoration faces a fundamental tradeoff: methods that minimize error produce blurry reconstructions, while those that maximize perceptual quality yield sharp but less faithful images. Existing approaches either commit to a single operating point on this distortion perception (DP) frontier or require paired-data supervision, auxiliary models, or hyperparameter tuning of the sampler to access different points. We show that flow map models, a recent extension of flow matching for few-step sa

summary.core_problem: 图像逆问题中，如何用同一个生成式 denoiser 在失真低和感知质量高之间连续调节。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成建模与逆问题的原理分析。它不直接服务 LLM 预训练，但对理解 flow matching 模型的可控采样和感知-失真权衡有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文研究 flow map models，这是一类面向少步采样的 flow matching 扩展，学习平均场。作者指出其中的 lookahead 参数 t 可作为控制旋钮，使同一个 denoiser 从 MMSE 风格的低失真重建连续移动到更感知化的锐利重建。在 Gaussian target 下给出理论证明，并将机制放入 Plug-and-Play solver 处理一般逆问题。
summary.experiments: 理论部分证明 Gaussian 目标下改变 t 可精确恢复最优 distortion-perception frontier；自然图像实验观察到类似行为。摘要未提供模型规模、数据集名称、baseline 列表或具体提升数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how a single generative denoiser can continuously trade off distortion and perceptual quality in image inverse problems.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an analysis and method for flow-based generative denoisers. It is not LLM pretraining work, but it is relevant as a clean example of controllability in flow-matching-style generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors study flow map models, an extension of flow matching for few-step sampling that learns an average field. They show that the lookahead parameter t acts as a knob moving the denoiser between MMSE-like reconstructions and perceptual outputs, and plug this denoiser into a Plug-and-Play inverse-problem solver.
summary_en.experiments: For Gaussian targets, they prove that varying t exactly recovers the optimal distortion-perception frontier. On natural images, they report similar empirical behavior, though the provided abstract does not include model sizes, datasets, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 不必细读应用实验；看 Gaussian 证明和 t 控制 DP frontier 的推导，可能类比到 flow/denoising LM。
recommendation.en: Skip the restoration benchmarks; read the Gaussian argument and the t-controlled frontier as a possible analogy for flow or denoising LMs.

paper.title: Emyx: Fast and efficient all-atom protein generation
paper.abstract: Computational enzyme design requires generating proteins that scaffold catalytic residues and ligands, a task that demands both geometric accuracy and structural diversity from the underlying generative model. Current all-atom generators inherit expensive architectures from structure prediction, leading to high training costs and limited sample diversity. We argue that much of this complexity is unnecessary for generators, which condition on sparse geometric constraints rather than rich co-evolu

summary.core_problem: 现有全原子蛋白质生成模型训练成本高、采样多样性不足，且流匹配训练范式无法复用扩散模型的先进采样方法
summary.importance: 方法创新（轻量条件流匹配架构+通用流匹配-EDM重参数化方法），工程突破（140M参数实现高效全原子蛋白质生成）
summary.technical_approach: 1）用标准Transformer块集中建模容量，以轻量条件表示和稀疏连接替代重型嵌入栈；2）推导精确重参数化，将流匹配插值映射到EDM噪声水平框架，无需重训练即可复用扩散模型SOTA采样方法
summary.experiments: 140M参数条件流匹配模型，摘要未完整披露实验细节，仅提及训练成本更低、采样速度更快、结构多样性优于现有全原子生成器

summary_en.core_problem: Existing all-atom protein generators suffer from high training costs, limited sample diversity, and incompatibility between flow matching training and advanced diffusion sampling methods
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation (lightweight conditional flow matching architecture + universal flow-matching-to-EDM reparameterization) and engineering breakthrough (efficient all-atom protein generation with 140M parameters)
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Concentrates capacity in standard Transformer blocks, replacing heavy embedding stacks with lightweight conditional representations and sparse connectivity; 2) Derives an exact reparameterization mapping flow matching interpolants to the EDM noise-level framework, enabling reuse of SOTA diffusion samplers without retraining
summary_en.experiments: 140M-parameter conditional flow matching model; full experimental details not disclosed in abstract, only mentions lower training cost, faster sampling, and higher structural diversity than existing all-atom generators

recommendation.zh: 仅关注流匹配到EDM的重参数化推导部分，其余为蛋白质生成领域内容，对文本Flow LM采样优化有弱参考价值
recommendation.en: Only read the flow-matching-to-EDM reparameterization derivation; the rest is protein-specific, with weak reference for text Flow LM sampling optimization.

paper.title: FlowBender: Feedback-Aware Training for Self-Correcting Conditional Flows
paper.abstract: Conditional diffusion and flow models routinely fail to satisfy the very constraints that define their task. For instance, a depth-conditioned model often produces images whose re-extracted depth disagrees with the input, even though the forward operator--the depth predictor defining the constraint--is available during both training and inference. Existing approaches generally fall into two categories: supervised models that treat the conditioning signal as a static cue and ignore alignment info

summary.core_problem: 条件扩散/流匹配模型在生成时无法稳定满足任务定义的约束（如深度图条件生成的图像，重提取的深度与输入条件不一致）——尽管用于将生成样本映射回条件信号空间的前向算子H（如深度预测器、边缘检测器、渲染器）在训练和推理阶段都可用。现有两类方法都有固有缺陷：监督式方法将条件视为静态输入，推理时为开环系统，不会利用约束偏差信号；推理时引导法靠手动调参的线性梯度更新修正轨迹，存在训练-推理不一致，且必须在约束保真度和样本合理性之间做权衡。
summary.importance: 对多模态统一预训练（尤其是AR+扩散联合建模范式）的目标设计有明确启发：将模型自身的对齐误差作为一等输入进行训练的闭环思路，可解决传统条件生成预训练中「开环训练+推理引导」的训练-推理不一致问题，同时支持不可微/黑箱约束的建模，无需手动调参即可同时提升约束保真度和样本质量。
summary.technical_approach: 提出FlowBender闭环采样框架，每步采样分两个阶段执行：1）无引导前瞻前向计算，估计当前步对应的干净信号，通过前向算子H计算生成结果与条件的任务特定偏差信号；2）修正前向计算，将偏差信号与常规输入（带噪样本、时间步、条件信号）共同输入模型，输出校正后的轨迹更新，将采样轨迹拉回符合约束的流形。三个关键设计：① 修正策略为非线性，不是梯度引导的标量加权（正交分解显示80%的修正能量与梯度方向正交，无法被传统引导法表达）；② 零阶变体直接输入原始测量空间的误差，无需梯度，支持不可微/黑箱算子（如JPEG压缩、第三方API）；③ 前步捷径机制将N步采样的推理成本压缩至最低N+1次网络前向，接近开环方法的推理效率，同时保留修正效果。框架架构无关，可兼容ControlNet、LoRA等现有适配器。
summary.experiments: 在3D纹理生成、JPEG修复、图像翻译（超分、深度/边缘转RGB）三类任务上，一致优于标准监督训练、对齐损失增强训练、现有推理引导法；且同时提升约束保真度和样本合理性（如FID指标），打破传统引导法的保真-合理性权衡规律。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看论文引言中开环/引导法两类失效模式的拆解、框架章节的三个核心设计细节、分析部分的正交分解消融实验（证明修正策略不是简单优化调参的引导法）；泛读约20分钟，可跳过具体实验的超参数细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Conditional diffusion and flow matching models consistently fail to satisfy task-defining constraints during generation (e.g., depth-conditioned outputs have re-extracted depth mismatched with input conditions) — even though the forward operator H (e.g., depth predictor, edge detector, renderer, which maps generated samples back to the condition signal space) is available in both training and inference. Existing two paradigms have inherent flaws: supervised methods treat conditioning as static input and run open-loop at inference, leaving constraint deviation signals unused; inference-time guidance relies on manually tuned linear gradient updates to steer trajectories, causing train-test mismatch and a forced trade-off between constraint fidelity and sample plausibility.
summary_en.importance: It delivers clear insights for objective design in unified multimodal pretraining, especially AR+diffusion joint paradigms. The closed-loop idea of training on the model’s own alignment error as a first-class input resolves the train-test mismatch in traditional conditional generation pretraining (open-loop training + inference-time guidance), supports modeling of non-differentiable/black-box constraints, and improves both constraint fidelity and sample quality without manual hyperparameter tuning.
summary_en.technical_approach: FlowBender is a closed-loop sampling framework with two stages per sampling step: 1) an unguided look-ahead forward pass estimates the clean signal at the current step, and the forward operator H computes task-specific deviation between the generated result and the condition; 2) a refinement forward pass takes the deviation plus standard inputs (noisy sample, timestep, conditioning signal) to output a corrected trajectory update, pulling the sampling trajectory back to the constraint-satisfying manifold. Three key designs: 1) the correction policy is nonlinear, not scalar-weighted gradient guidance (orthogonal decomposition shows 80% of correction energy is orthogonal to gradient directions, which cannot be expressed by traditional guidance schemes); 2) a zero-order variant feeds raw measurement-space error directly without requiring gradients, supporting non-differentiable/black-box operators (e.g., JPEG compression, third-party APIs); 3) a prior-step shortcut reduces inference cost of N-step sampling to as low as N+1 forward passes, approaching open-loop efficiency while retaining correction benefits. The framework is architecture-agnostic and compatible with existing adapters like ControlNet and LoRA.
summary_en.experiments: Across three task categories: 3D texturing, JPEG restoration, and image translation (super-resolution, depth/edge-to-RGB), it consistently outperforms standard supervised training, alignment-loss augmented training, and existing inference-time guidance methods. It simultaneously improves constraint fidelity and sample plausibility (e.g., FID metric), breaking the fidelity-plausibility trade-off observed in traditional guidance approaches.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the failure mode breakdown for open-loop and guidance paradigms in the paper’s introduction, three core design details in the framework section, and the orthogonal decomposition ablation in the analysis section (proving the correction policy is not just better-tuned guidance). Skim time: ~20 minutes, skip detailed hyperparameter settings in experiment results.

recommendation.zh: 把推理时约束误差回灌训练的闭环思路，可直接迁移到LLM后训练中的自校正/推理时反馈对齐，重点看§3训练目标设计。
recommendation.en: Closed-loop idea of feeding inference-time constraint error back into training transfers directly to LLM post-training self-correction / inference-time feedback alignment; focus on §3 training objective design.

paper.title: Learning When to Denoise: Optimizing Asynchronous Schedules for Latent Diffusion
paper.abstract: Multi-representation diffusion models can improve visual synthesis by denoising complementary views of an image, but their performance depends critically on the asynchronous schedule that determines when each representation is denoised. We propose to learn this schedule. Our method formulates asynchronous flow matching over multiple representation spaces and uses a schedule-corrected objective that keeps each representation's local noising-time weights fixed as the schedule changes. We instantia

summary.core_problem: 多表示 latent diffusion 中，不同表示空间何时去噪会显著影响生成质量，论文试图自动学习这个异步去噪时间表。
summary.importance: 贡献是扩散/flow matching 训练 recipe 的改进，重点在多表示生成模型的 schedule 优化。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但对离散/连续 diffusion LM 或统一多模态生成中的时间调度有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把多表示空间上的异步去噪写成 asynchronous flow matching，并提出 schedule-corrected objective：当 schedule 改变时，保持每个表示的局部 noising-time 权重不变，避免把 schedule 学习和训练权重变化混在一起。schedule 使用凸且单调的参数化形式，并通过一个小成本 joint probe 学习，额外训练计算小于 1%。
summary.experiments: 在 ImageNet 256x256 上使用匹配的 675M 参数 XL backbone。学习到的 schedule 提升收敛速度和最终质量；配合 AutoGuidance，200 epoch 模型达到 FID 1.05，接近 800 epoch SFD-XL baseline；训练到 600 epoch 时 FID 进一步到 1.02。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when each representation should be denoised in multi-representation latent diffusion, where the asynchronous schedule strongly affects generation quality.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-recipe improvement for diffusion and flow-matching generative models. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but the schedule-learning idea may be relevant to diffusion LMs or unified multimodal generators with multiple latent spaces.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method formulates asynchronous flow matching across multiple representation spaces and introduces a schedule-corrected objective that keeps each representation's local noising-time weights fixed as the schedule changes. The schedule is parameterized to be convex and monotone by construction and is learned with a fast joint probe costing less than 1% extra training compute.
summary_en.experiments: On ImageNet 256x256 with a matched 675M-parameter XL backbone, the learned schedule improves convergence and final quality. With AutoGuidance, a 200-epoch model reaches FID 1.05, matching the 800-epoch SFD-XL baseline; extending training to 600 epochs gives FID 1.02.

recommendation.zh: 只看 objective 校正和 schedule 参数化；对 diffusion LM 有类比价值，但图像 FID 结果不能直接外推到文本。
recommendation.en: Read only the objective correction and schedule parameterization; the analogy to diffusion LMs is useful, but ImageNet FID should not be over-interpreted for text.

paper.title: FlowEdit: Associative Memory for Lifelong Pronunciation Adaptation in Flow-Matching TTS
paper.abstract: Flow-matching text-to-speech systems achieve remarkable zero-shot quality but remain static after deployment: pronunciation errors on out-of-vocabulary proper nouns persist unless the model is retrained. We introduce FlowEdit, a life-long adaptation framework for frozen flow-matching TTS that learns pronunciation corrections as latent conditioning edits rather than weight updates. When corrective feedback is provided, FlowEdit optimizes a token-level perturbation in the text embedding space, the

summary.core_problem: 流匹配 TTS 在部署后难以持续修正专有名词发音错误，传统做法往往需要重新训练模型。
summary.importance: 这是语音生成方向的部署后适配工作。与 LLM 基座预训练的直接关系不强，但它把“冻结主模型 + 外部可寻址记忆 + 输入侧编辑”用于持续个性化修正，这种设计对语音LM和统一生成系统有一点参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FlowEdit：冻结 flow-matching TTS 主模型，不做权重更新；当收到纠错反馈时，在文本嵌入空间优化 token-level perturbation，把这种发音修正表示存入 Modern Hopfield Network 作为联想式 episodic memory。推理时通过相似度检索与软注意力门控取回修正，从而支持模糊形态匹配。
summary.experiments: 在作者构建的 312 个多语言专有名词、覆盖 18 个语系的 benchmark 上评估。相对 zero-shot baseline，目标词 Phoneme Error Rate 降低 92.7%，同时保持一般语音质量不变；单次修正约 15 秒完成。实验看起来更像部署适配验证，而非大规模预训练研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Flow-matching TTS systems struggle to correct pronunciation errors on proper nouns after deployment, and the usual fix is retraining.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-deployment adaptation paper for speech generation. It is not directly central to LLM pretraining, but the design pattern—frozen backbone plus external addressable memory plus input-side edits—has some relevance for speech LMs and unified generative systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes FlowEdit: keep the flow-matching TTS model frozen, and when corrective feedback arrives, optimize a token-level perturbation in text-embedding space instead of updating weights. The correction is stored in a Modern Hopfield Network as associative episodic memory, and retrieved at inference with similarity-based soft attention and gating, enabling fuzzy morphological matching.
summary_en.experiments: It evaluates on a curated benchmark of 312 multilingual proper nouns across 18 language families. Relative to the zero-shot baseline, target-word phoneme error rate drops by 92.7% while preserving general speech quality, and each correction takes about 15 seconds. This reads more like deployment adaptation than pretraining research.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“冻结骨干+输入编辑+外部记忆”这个配方在语音LM里挺干净；看方法图就够，别把它误读成通用持续学习方案。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the frozen-backbone + input-edit + external-memory recipe is clean in speech; read the method figure and do not overgeneralize it as lifelong learning.

paper.title: Reference-Driven Multi-Speaker Audio Scene Generation from In-the-Wild Priors
paper.abstract: Existing multi-speaker dialogue systems bind speakers to utterances through structured supervision: per-turn tags, multi-stream transcriptions, or learnable speaker embeddings. These systems operate within speech-only pipelines that produce clean vocal sequences without the ambient texture of real conversations. We take a different approach. Our method, ScenA, conditions a text-to-audio flow-matching foundation model, pretrained on large-scale in-the-wild data, directly on multiple reference voi

summary.core_problem: 在“多说话人+真实环境纹理”的端到端音频场景生成里，如何在不引入逐轮 speaker tag / 多流转写 / 额外说话人编码器的前提下，让模型可靠地把“参考音色”绑定到提示词里指定的角色与台词位置；并解决 flow-matching 训练中一个会导致训练-推理失配的失败模式（reference shortcut）。
summary.importance: 对“把音频当作基础模型来预训练/续训”的研究更有启发点：它把一个看似是条件控制的小问题，追到训练目标与噪声日程分布导致的系统性捷径学习。结论很工程化：参考条件的扩散/flow 模型在低噪区间会泄漏足够的目标信息，使模型用“相似度匹配”绕开文本绑定信号，训练 loss 很好但从纯噪声采样时崩溃。解决手段不是加模块，而是改 timestep 采样分布，把训练质量压到“必须依赖文本”的高噪区间。这类分析对多模态统一建模里常见的条件泄漏、shortcut learning、以及训练分布与采样分布不一致问题都可复用。
summary.technical_approach:
基座是一个预训练的 text-to-audio diffusion transformer（在 VAE latent token 序列上做 flow-matching）。目标音频 latent z0 被加噪得到 zt；K 段参考说话人音频用同一个 VAE 编码成 rk，但参考不加噪。模型输入是把 [zt; r1; ...; rK] 直接拼接进同一个自注意力序列，让 target 与 reference token 自由交互；用“slot identity embedding”区分不同 reference（每个 reference 槽位一个可学习向量 ek，加到该参考的所有 token 上），不引入额外说话人编码器或 reference adapter。文本提示是唯一的绑定接口：用自然语言描述整段场景，并用“reference 1/2 ...”指代对应音色。

关键贡献在 reference shortcut 的定位与修复：标准训练常用的 logit-normal timestep 分布把大量训练质量放在低到中噪声；此时 zt 仍保留明显声学特征，模型可以通过比较 zt 与 rk 的相似度来“选对说话人”，从而在训练时几乎不需要读文本里关于谁说哪句的绑定信息。推理从纯噪声开始，这条捷径不存在，导致绑定灾难。作者用冻结音频特征训练一个小 probe，验证在低/中噪区间确实能稳定做 reference-target 匹配；再做噪声日程消融，观察到随着训练质量向高噪移动，绑定指标单调提升。最终用 Beta+Uniform 混合的 timestep 分布显式偏向高噪区间，迫使模型在训练时只能依赖文本来完成绑定，从而消除训练-推理失配。
summary.experiments: 在 CoVoMix2-Dialogue 基准上评测多说话人对话生成，报告“speaker-binding”相关指标上与现有多说话人对话 TTS/对话生成基线相比持平或更好；在更难的 in-the-wild reference 子集上优势更明显（参考音频从录音棚干净语音变成真实噪声录音）。核心实验证据链包括：(1) 朴素训练会出现训练 loss 低但推理绑定差的现象；(2) probe 显示低/中噪区间可用相似度匹配 reference；(3) timestep 分布向高噪迁移时，绑定指标随之单调改善；(4) slot encoding 形式（加性 embedding vs RoPE 等）有消融。给定当前提供的全文片段，具体数值（如各指标提升幅度、模型规模、训练数据规模）未完整出现，需以论文表格为准。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读优先抓两块：
1) §3.2 reference shortcut：失败模式的定义、为什么会导致训练-推理失配、probe 如何证明“低噪可相似度匹配”。这部分是可迁移的训练动态洞察。
2) §3.3 timestep distribution：Beta+Uniform 混合分布的动机、参数选择、以及噪声日程消融图（通常是绑定指标 vs 噪声质量分配）。
其余部分（§3.1 拼接式 reference conditioning、Appendix 的 slot encoding 消融）快速扫一遍即可。预计 30-45 分钟能把主要结论读清楚；若要复现/迁移到图像或多模态条件控制，建议精读噪声分布与评测指标定义。

summary_en.core_problem: How to generate realistic multi-speaker audio scenes (overlap, room acoustics, background events) while reliably binding multiple reference voices to the roles/utterances specified only in a free-form text prompt—without turn-level speaker tags, multi-stream transcripts, or extra speaker encoders—and how to fix a training-time shortcut in reference-conditioned flow matching that breaks binding at inference.
summary_en.importance: The main value for foundation-model pretraining work is the diagnosis of a distributional/objective failure mode rather than a new module. With standard timestep sampling, the noised target still contains enough acoustic identity cues, so the model can minimize loss by matching target-to-reference via similarity and effectively ignore the text binding signal. Sampling starts from pure noise at inference, so the shortcut disappears and binding collapses. The paper shows a clean lever: change the timestep distribution to emphasize high-noise regimes where the target is uninformative and text is the only viable binding signal. This is broadly relevant to shortcut learning and train–sample mismatch in diffusion/flow models with strong conditional inputs.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Built on a pretrained text-to-audio diffusion transformer trained with flow matching over VAE latent tokens. The target audio is encoded to z0 and noised to zt; K reference clips are encoded with the same VAE to rk and kept clean. The transformer input is a single concatenated token sequence [zt; r1; ...; rK] with full self-attention across target and references. References are distinguished by lightweight slot identity embeddings (one learned vector per reference slot, added to all tokens of that reference) rather than speaker encoders/adapters. A single holistic natural-language prompt describes the whole scene and refers to voices as “reference 1/2/...”.

Core technical contribution: identifying the “reference shortcut” in reference-conditioned flow matching. Under the commonly used logit-normal timestep distribution, training mass concentrates on low-to-moderate noise where zt still preserves speaker cues; the model can pick the correct reference by acoustic similarity, achieving low loss while ignoring text-based role binding. Since generation starts from pure noise, this shortcut is unavailable at test time. The authors localize the shortcut with a probe trained on frozen audio features, showing robust reference–target matching across the low/moderate noise range, and then run noise-schedule ablations showing binding metrics improve monotonically as training shifts to higher noise. They fix it by using a high-noise-biased timestep distribution (a Beta+Uniform mixture) to force reliance on text for binding.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on CoVoMix2-Dialogue with speaker-binding-focused metrics. ScenA matches or exceeds prior multi-speaker dialogue baselines across binding metrics, with a larger margin on an in-the-wild reference subset (noisy real recordings vs studio-clean references). The key empirical chain is: naive training yields low training loss but poor binding at inference; the probe confirms similarity-based matching is feasible in the low/moderate noise region; shifting timestep mass toward higher noise monotonically improves binding; slot-encoding variants are ablated (additive slot embeddings vs alternatives). The provided excerpt does not include the full numeric tables (model size, data scale, exact deltas), so those must be taken from the main results tables/appendix.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim with focus on two sections: (1) the reference-shortcut analysis (definition, why it creates train–sample mismatch, the probe experiment), and (2) the timestep-distribution fix (Beta+Uniform mixture, ablations showing monotonic binding gains as noise increases). The conditioning mechanism (concatenation + slot embeddings) is straightforward; scan the appendix for slot-encoding ablations if you plan to reuse the interface. ~30–45 minutes for the main idea; longer if you want to port the noise-sampling recipe to other conditional diffusion settings.

recommendation.zh: 将多说话人参考音频作为 token 序列拼接，并用位置编码区分身份，这种在连续空间做 in-context condition 的思路对音频 LM 架构设计有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Concatenating multi-speaker reference audio as token sequences and distinguishing identities with positional encoding provides valuable insights for in-context conditioning in audio LM architectures.

paper.title: SpectralDiT: Timestep-Conditioned Spectral Residual Correction for Flow-Matching DiTs
paper.abstract: We propose SpectralDiT, a lightweight modification to flow-matching Diffusion Transformers that adds timestep-conditioned spectral correction to the MLP residual branch. The module decomposes each residual update into low- and high-frequency components on the patch-token grid, then learns a zero-initialized additive gate so the model initially matches the baseline DiT. On CIFAR-10 pixel-space generation, SpectralDiT improves FID from 20.78 to 19.71 at patch size 1 and reduces the radial Fourier

summary.core_problem: 改进 flow-matching Diffusion Transformer 在图像生成中的频谱建模，使残差更新更好覆盖低频和高频成分。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是图像生成架构的小幅改进。它对 LLM 预训练不是直接相关，但 DiT/flow matching 是多模态生成基座的常用组件，频谱残差分析对视觉 tokenizer 或统一生成模型的视觉分支有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SpectralDiT，在 DiT 的 MLP residual branch 中加入 timestep-conditioned spectral correction。模块在 patch-token 网格上把残差更新分解为低频和高频分量，并使用 zero-initialized additive gate，使训练初始行为与 baseline DiT 一致，再逐步学习频谱校正。
summary.experiments: 在 CIFAR-10 pixel-space generation 上，FID 从 20.78 降到 19.71，并缩小 radial Fourier spectrum gap；在 ImageNet-100 latent diffusion 上，增加 0.6% 理论 FLOPs 和 1.36% 参数量，在 CFG 2.0 下获得 8.7% 相对 FID 降幅。结果报告为五个随机种子的平均值，并提供 CIFAR-10 上的消融和 gate 可视化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper improves frequency modeling in flow-matching Diffusion Transformers for image generation by adding spectral residual correction.
summary_en.importance: This is a small architecture modification for image generation. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but DiT and flow matching are common components in multimodal generative foundation models, and the spectral-residual analysis may be useful for visual branches or unified generation systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpectralDiT adds a timestep-conditioned spectral correction module to the MLP residual branch of a DiT. The module decomposes residual updates into low- and high-frequency components on the patch-token grid, and uses a zero-initialized additive gate so the model initially behaves like the baseline before learning spectral corrections.
summary_en.experiments: On CIFAR-10 pixel-space generation, FID improves from 20.78 to 19.71 and the radial Fourier spectrum gap is reduced. On ImageNet-100 latent diffusion, the method adds 0.6% theoretical FLOPs and 1.36% parameters, and reports an 8.7% relative FID reduction under CFG 2.0. Results are averaged over five seeds, with ablations and gate visualizations on CIFAR-10.

recommendation.zh: 看实验表和 gate 可视化即可；这是干净的 DiT 小补丁，可能有用，但还不足以改变对 flow matching 架构的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the result table and gate visualizations only; it is a clean DiT patch that may be useful, but it does not yet change the prior on flow-matching architectures.

paper.title: The Reward Was in Your Data All Along: Correcting Flow Matching with Discriminator-Guided RL
paper.abstract: Score- and flow-matching models often rely on preference-based reinforcement learning for two purposes: aligning with subjective preferences and, surprisingly, recovering properties such as visual realism and coherent object structure that matching-based training is intended to learn from the data itself. We argue that this reflects a structural mismatch. Matching losses measure $\ell_2$ regression error on the velocity or score field under training-time marginals, a proxy poorly aligned with th

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的问题不是“如何再做一个图像生成 RL trick”，而是更基础的一点：为什么 flow/score matching 这类本来就是为了拟合数据分布而设计的训练目标，仍然会漏掉数据中已经存在的高层属性，比如视觉真实感、物体结构一致性、物理合理性，最后还要靠 RL 再补回来。作者把矛头指向 matching objective 本身的结构失配：训练时最小化的是插值分布上的速度场或 score 场的 L2 回归误差，但推理时真正决定样本质量的是模型自己 rollout 后落到哪里，以及这些样本在语义空间里是否保留了数据分布的关键性质。也就是说，问题不一定是数据不够、模型不够大，而可能是训练目标对“我们真正关心的性质”控制得太弱。
summary.importance: 虽然论文对象是连续域生成模型，不是文本 LLM，但它对基座预训练研究有很强的方法论价值。第一，它清楚地区分了‘拟合训练分布上的局部回归目标’和‘控制模型自采样分布上的全局性质’这两件事，这个张力在 diffusion LM、non-AR generation、甚至标准 AR 预训练里都存在。第二，它把 RL 的角色从“只做偏好对齐”扩展为“修正 pretrain objective 的结构性盲点”，这对理解 pretrain↔post-train 闭环很有启发。第三，论文提出的 discriminator-guided reward 不是依赖人工偏好，而是从数据与模型分布差异中构造奖励，这种思路对未来做 data-aware RL pretrain、self-rewarded continual training、以及 representation-space correction 都有借鉴意义。贡献量级上，这更像一篇把训练目标、分布偏移和 RL 角色重新摆正的机制型工作。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分两层。第一层是理论分析。作者在 probability-flow ODE 框架下研究一个性质 gap：|E_pbase[r] - E_q[r]|，其中 r 是某个我们关心的样本属性。结论是，FSM loss 对这个 gap 的控制很弱。最坏情况下甚至没有保证，因为训练损失是在插值边缘分布 q_t 上度量，而生成时模型实际遵循的是自己的 rollout 分布 p_t；两者一旦偏离，训练时的回归误差小，并不意味着采样后的属性也对。即便在附加正则条件下能得到保证，这个保证也会随着 reward 的 L2 Lipschitz 常数恶化，而很多语义或感知质量相关的性质恰恰是高曲率、非平滑的。

第二层是方法设计：Discriminator-Guided RL，简称 DRL。它不使用偏好数据，而是训练一个判别器去估计数据分布 q 与当前模型分布 p_model 在自监督表示空间中的 density ratio。更具体地说，把真实样本和模型样本都映射到一个预训练 SSL encoder 的特征空间，在这个空间里训练一个简单判别器区分 data vs model；判别器 logit 作为 reward，随后做 KL-regularized RL，把模型往‘更像数据分布’的方向推。这里最关键的设计不是 RL 本身，而是 reward 定义在 SSL representation space，而不是像素空间。原因有两个：一是高维原空间做 density-ratio estimation 很难，二是表示空间天然过滤掉很多低层噪声，把修正限制在语义上更有意义的方向。

这个方法与 preference-based RL 的区别很明确。PRL 优化的是外部偏好函数，往往同时混合了主观偏好和客观质量；DRL 优化的是“模型分布相对数据分布还缺了什么”，因此它更像对 pretraining objective 的补偿项。与直接改 matching loss 相比，DRL 选择 post-hoc RL，是因为 RL 可以在模型自己的采样轨迹上评估并优化 reward，绕开 q_t 与 p_t 不一致的问题。
summary.experiments:
实验在多种图像生成架构上验证，包括 SiT、JiT、REPA、RAE。作者强调的一点是，DRL 使用的判别器可以很简单，甚至线性分类器就足以带来稳定收益，这说明改进并不依赖一个很强的 reward model，而是来自 reward 构造方式本身。评测主要看多个特征空间下的 Fréchet distance，并额外检查 held-out human-preference rewards。主结果是：相对 base model，DRL 在各架构上都能显著改善分布质量指标；更重要的是，这些改善还能迁移到未参与训练的人类偏好奖励上，说明它不是只在某个特征空间里过拟合。

论文还有一个很有价值的实验设置：先做 DRL，再叠加 preference-based RL，与直接在 base model 上做 PRL 比较 reward–distortion Pareto frontier。结果是前者更好，因为 DRL 先把那些本应由数据分布提供、但 matching objective 没学好的结构性属性补回来，PRL 就可以把容量更多用在真正主观的偏好上，而不是拿偏好数据去修复基础 realism/structure 问题。这一点对 post-training pipeline 设计很重要。

从你关心的角度，最值得看的是实验是否证明了“不是数据不够，而是 objective mismatch”。如果全文里有随着 base model 变强、DRL 仍然有效的结果，那会进一步支持这个论点。当前给出的正文片段没有包含完整数字表，因此不能准确复述具体提升幅度，但实验叙事已经很清楚：多架构一致收益、简单判别器有效、对 held-out preference reward 也有正迁移、并且能改善后续 PRL 的效率。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议按这个顺序。先看 Introduction，抓住论文真正的问题意识：RL 不只是加偏好，很多时候是在修正 matching training 没学到的数据属性。然后直接看理论部分关于 property gap 的分析，尤其是 q_t 上训练、p_t 上采样这组不一致，以及 Lipschitz 依赖为什么会让很多感知属性难以由 FSM loss 保证。理解了这一点，再看 DRL 方法就会很顺。方法部分重点看三个问题：为什么选 SSL representation space；density-ratio discriminator 如何训练；KL-regularized RL 如何接入现有 flow model pipeline。实验部分优先看两类表：一类是 base model vs DRL 的主结果，另一类是 DRL+PRL 与直接 PRL 的 Pareto 对比。预计 30 分钟可以完成一次高质量泛读；如果你做 diffusion LM、flow matching LM 或者在思考 RL 是否能反哺 pretrain objective，这篇值得细看理论章节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a deeper question than how to add another RL stage to image generation: why do flow- and score-matching models, which are explicitly trained to fit the data distribution, still fail to preserve properties already present in the data—such as realism, coherent object structure, or physically plausible motion—and then recover them only after RL post-training? The paper argues that the bottleneck is often the matching objective itself. Training minimizes an L2 regression error on velocity or score fields under interpolation marginals, while sample quality at inference depends on where the model’s own rollout distribution ends up and whether those samples preserve semantically important properties of the data. In other words, the issue may be objective mismatch rather than insufficient data or model capacity.
summary_en.importance: Even though the setting is continuous-domain generative modeling rather than text LLM pretraining, the methodological relevance is high. First, the paper cleanly separates fitting a local regression target under training-time marginals from controlling global properties under the model’s self-generated distribution. That tension also appears in diffusion LMs, non-autoregressive language modeling, and even standard AR pretraining. Second, it reframes RL from being only a preference-alignment tool to being a mechanism for correcting structural blind spots of the pretraining objective. That is directly relevant to the pretrain–post-train loop. Third, the proposed reward is not based on human preference labels but on discrepancies between data and model distributions in a learned representation space. This is a useful template for data-aware RL pretraining, self-corrective continual training, and representation-space reward construction. The contribution is best read as a mechanism paper that clarifies the role of RL relative to the base objective.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has two layers. The first is theoretical. In a probability-flow ODE setting, the paper studies a property gap of the form |E_pbase[r] - E_q[r]|, where r is a property of interest. The conclusion is that flow/score matching gives weak control over this gap. In the worst case, there is no guarantee at all, because the training loss is measured under interpolation marginals q_t, whereas generation is governed by the model’s own rollout distribution p_t. Once those differ, small regression error under q_t does not imply that sampled outputs preserve the desired property. Under additional regularity assumptions, one can derive a bound, but it degrades with the L2 Lipschitz constant of the reward. Many semantic or perceptual properties are precisely the kind of high-curvature, non-smooth functions for which such guarantees become weak.

The second layer is the method: Discriminator-Guided RL (DRL). Instead of using preference data, DRL trains a discriminator to estimate the density ratio between the data distribution and the current model distribution in a self-supervised representation space. Real samples and model samples are embedded by a pretrained SSL encoder; a discriminator is trained in that feature space to distinguish data from model outputs; the discriminator logit is then used as the reward for KL-regularized RL. The central design choice is to define the reward in SSL feature space rather than pixel space. This makes density-ratio estimation more tractable and constrains the correction to semantically meaningful directions instead of low-level noise.

This differs from preference-based RL in a precise way. PRL optimizes an external reward that often mixes subjective preference with objective quality. DRL instead optimizes what the model distribution is still missing relative to the data distribution, making it closer to a corrective term for the pretraining objective. It also differs from directly modifying the matching loss: RL is used because it evaluates and optimizes the reward on the model’s own sampled trajectories, thereby bypassing the q_t versus p_t mismatch.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical study spans several modern image-generation architectures, including SiT, JiT, REPA, and RAE. One notable result is that the discriminator used by DRL can be very simple—even a linear classifier is sufficient to produce consistent gains. That suggests the improvement is not coming from an unusually powerful reward model, but from the way the reward is constructed. Evaluation is based mainly on Fréchet distances in multiple feature spaces, with additional checks using held-out human-preference rewards. The main finding is that DRL improves distribution-quality metrics over the base model across architectures, and these gains transfer to unseen human-preference rewards despite never training on preference labels.

A particularly important experiment compares two pipelines: applying preference-based RL directly to the base model versus applying PRL on top of a DRL-corrected model. The latter yields a better reward–distortion Pareto frontier. The interpretation is straightforward: DRL first recovers structural properties that should have come from the data but were not fully captured by the matching objective, leaving PRL to focus on genuinely subjective preferences rather than spending preference data to repair basic realism or coherence. That has clear implications for post-training pipeline design.

From a foundation-model perspective, the key empirical question is whether the paper really supports the claim that the issue is objective mismatch rather than lack of data. If the full paper shows DRL remaining useful even as the base model gets stronger, that would strengthen the argument further. The excerpt provided here does not include the full numeric tables, so exact gains should not be fabricated. Still, the experimental story is already clear: consistent gains across architectures, simple discriminators suffice, held-out preference rewards improve, and downstream PRL becomes more efficient.
summary_en.reading_guide: A good skim starts with the introduction, focusing on the paper’s central claim: RL is often repairing properties that matching-based training failed to capture from the data itself. Then move to the theory section on the property gap. The most important points are the mismatch between training under q_t and sampling under p_t, and why the dependence on the reward’s Lipschitz constant makes many perceptual properties hard to control through FSM losses alone. Once that is clear, the DRL method becomes much easier to interpret. In the method section, focus on three questions: why use an SSL representation space, how the density-ratio discriminator is trained, and how KL-regularized RL is integrated into the existing flow-model pipeline. In the experiments, prioritize the main base-model-versus-DRL results and the DRL+PRL versus direct PRL Pareto comparison. A solid skim should take around 30 minutes. If you work on diffusion LMs, flow-matching language models, or the role of RL in correcting pretraining objectives, the theory section is worth a closer read.

recommendation.zh: Cohere 提出的判别器引导 RL 方法，用判别器替代人类偏好作为 Reward，对探索 LLM/VLM 的 self-play 或无监督 RL 后训练有启发。
recommendation.en: Cohere's discriminator-guided RL replaces human preferences with a discriminator as the reward, inspiring explorations in self-play or unsupervised RL post-training for LLMs/VLMs.

paper.title: Perron--Frobenius Operator Matching for Generative Modeling
paper.abstract: We introduce Perron--Frobenius Operator Matching (PFOM), a generative framework that matches density evolution via the integral PF operator, subsuming flow, diffusion, and jump models. We prove that among Bregman divergences, only Kullback--Leibler divergence preserves equality between density-level and sample-conditioned objectives, yielding a practical loss equivalent to Koopman path matching. We further develop Nesterov-accelerated training and sampling that stabilize discretization and accel

summary.core_problem: 提出一个用Perron–Frobenius算子刻画密度演化的生成建模框架，试图统一flow、diffusion和jump模型。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏理论建模范式。它不是LLM论文，但与扩散、流匹配、跳跃过程等生成模型目标函数有关；对关注非AR语言建模的人有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为PFOM，通过匹配积分形式的Perron–Frobenius算子来学习密度演化。论文证明在Bregman divergence中，只有KL divergence能保持density-level目标和sample-conditioned目标的一致性，并得到一个等价于Koopman path matching的实用loss。同时引入Nesterov加速的训练和采样，以改善离散化稳定性和收敛速度。
summary.experiments: 实验主要在Gaussian mixtures和two-moons等低维合成分布上，报告KL、Wasserstein-2和MMD下降更快，并有wall-clock效率收益。摘要未显示高维图像、文本或语言模型实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper proposes a Perron–Frobenius-operator view of generative modeling that describes density evolution and aims to unify flows, diffusions, and jump models.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly a theoretical modeling framework. It is not an LLM paper, but it is adjacent to diffusion, flow matching, and jump-process objectives, so it may be indirectly useful for researchers tracking non-autoregressive language modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: PFOM matches the integral Perron–Frobenius operator governing density evolution. The paper proves that among Bregman divergences, only KL divergence preserves equivalence between density-level and sample-conditioned objectives, yielding a practical loss equivalent to Koopman path matching. It also adds Nesterov-accelerated training and sampling to stabilize discretization and speed convergence.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are mainly on low-dimensional synthetic distributions such as Gaussian mixtures and two-moons. The paper reports faster decreases in KL, W2, and MMD, plus better wall-clock efficiency. The abstract does not report high-dimensional image, text, or language-model experiments.

recommendation.zh: 作为非AR生成目标的数学备查即可；没有文本建模实验证据，别把二维toy上的收敛曲线外推到LM。
recommendation.en: Keep it as mathematical background for non-AR objectives; without text experiments, do not extrapolate toy-distribution convergence to LMs.

paper.title: MUNI: Multimodal Unified Latent Diffusion for Coherent Any-to-Any Generation
paper.abstract: We introduce MUNI, an end-to-end multimodal latent diffusion framework for any-to-any generation that unifies subset-conditioned cross-modal generation and unconditional joint sampling through a shared stochastic latent. Existing multimodal generative models are largely LLM-based, which limits leveraging modality-specific generators and requires text-paired data for training. Recent diffusion- and flow-based any-to-any extensions take a different direction but still rely on text-aligned embeddin

summary.core_problem: 现有任意模态到任意模态生成框架要么依赖LLM与文本配对数据，要么需要全配对训练、对齐嵌入或确定性维度匹配，难以端到端统一条件生成与无条件联合采样。
summary.importance: 范式创新，提出共享随机潜空间的多模态潜扩散统一框架，绕开文本对齐与全配对数据约束，为any-to-any生成提供新的端到端训练路径。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MUNI：1）架构上联合训练各模态编码器、解码器与单一共享flow-based先验，替代传统两阶段冻结潜空间+拟合先验的流程；2）训练目标上通过共享随机潜变量统一子集条件跨模态生成与无条件联合采样。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未披露具体模型规模、训练数据集大小与定量对比结果，仅给出框架设计与核心动机。
summary.authors_note: Cohere团队，Minhyuk Sung为通讯作者，团队长期从事3D与多模态生成研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing any-to-any multimodal generation frameworks either rely on LLMs with text-paired data or require fully-paired training, aligned embeddings, or deterministic dimension matching, failing to unify conditional cross-modal generation and unconditional joint sampling end-to-end.
summary_en.importance: Paradigm innovation: proposes a unified multimodal latent diffusion framework with a shared stochastic latent, bypassing text alignment and fully paired data constraints to enable end-to-end any-to-any generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: MUNI introduces two core designs: 1) architecturally, it jointly trains modality-specific encoders, decoders, and a single shared flow-based prior under one objective, replacing the standard two-stage frozen latent + prior fitting recipe; 2) the training objective unifies subset-conditioned cross-modal generation and unconditional joint sampling via the shared stochastic latent.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose specific model scales, training dataset sizes, or quantitative benchmark results; only framework design and core motivations are presented.
summary_en.authors_note: Cohere team, with Minhyuk Sung as corresponding author; the group has long worked on 3D and multimodal generation.

recommendation.zh: 共享潜空间+联合训练先验的思路对统一多模态预训练有参考，重点看§3的目标函数设计与模态接口定义。
recommendation.en: The shared latent space + jointly trained prior design offers useful references for unified multimodal pretraining; focus on §3 objective formulation and modality interface definitions.

paper.title: Exact Posterior Score Estimation for Solving Linear Inverse Problems
paper.abstract: Diffusion and flow-based models learn powerful data priors by training a denoiser to reverse Gaussian corruption. To use this prior to solve a linear inverse problem, one needs to sample from the posterior, but the score that the prior provides is the unconditional score, not the posterior score. Existing methods either steer a fixed pretrained denoiser with approximate measurement-matching corrections, or train a conditional restoration model that abandons the denoising structure of the prior.

summary.core_problem: 扩散/流模型求解线性逆问题时，训练得到的是无条件分数而非后验分数，现有方法只能近似修正或放弃去噪结构。
summary.importance: 理论推导贡献：首次给出一般高斯插值项下线性高斯逆问题精确后验分数的闭合形式。
summary.technical_approach: 推导了精确后验分数(EPS)的闭合形式，证明后验采样等价于算子依赖的平移枢轴处各向异性噪声协方差下的去噪问题；提出EPS训练目标，保留标准预训练的输入/输出结构，可从头训练或从预训练去噪模型微调。
summary.experiments: 摘要中未详述具体实验结果、基准和模型规模。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括Yee Whye Teh（Oxford/DeepMind）、James Matthew Rehg（Georgia Tech）。

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion/flow-based models for linear inverse problems face a fundamental gap: the trained score is unconditional, not the posterior score needed for conditional sampling.
summary_en.importance: Theoretical contribution: first closed-form exact posterior score for linear Gaussian inverse problems under general Gaussian interpolants.
summary_en.technical_approach: Derives Exact Posterior Score (EPS) in closed form, showing posterior sampling reduces to denoising at an operator-dependent shifted pivot under anisotropic noise covariance. EPS training objective preserves the input/output structure of standard pretraining, allowing both scratch training and fine-tuning from a pretrained denoiser.
summary_en.experiments: Detailed experimental results, baselines, and model sizes not described in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Yee Whye Teh (Oxford/DeepMind) and James Matthew Rehg (Georgia Tech).

recommendation.zh: 扩散模型后验分数的精确理论推导有学术价值，对理解Diffusion/Flow Matching的数学基础有启发；但应用于图像逆问题，与LLM预训练无直接关联，仅作理论背景备查。
recommendation.en: Exact posterior score derivation for diffusion models is academically interesting for Diffusion/Flow Matching theory but applied to image inverse problems; no direct relevance to LLM pretraining, suitable as theoretical background only.

paper.title: AudioX-Turbo: A Unified Framework for Efficient Anything-to-Audio Generation
paper.abstract: Audio and music generation based on flexible multimodal control signals is a widely applicable topic, with the following key challenges: 1) a unified multimodal modeling framework, 2) large-scale, high-quality training data, and 3) the prohibitive inference cost of multi-step diffusion sampling. As such, we propose AudioX-Turbo, a unified and efficient framework for anything-to-audio generation that integrates varied multimodal conditions (i.e., text, video, and audio signals) in this work. Audi

summary.core_problem: 灵活多模态条件下的音频/音乐生成存在统一建模框架缺失、高质量训练数据不足、扩散采样推理成本过高三大挑战。
summary.importance: 提出统一的任意模态到音频生成框架，配套构建大规模训练数据，属于多模态生成领域的方法+数据联合创新。
summary.technical_approach: 采用师生蒸馏范式：教师模型AudioX-Base基于多模态扩散Transformer+多模态自适应融合模块对齐文本/视频/音频条件；学生AudioX-Turbo通过适配流匹配的分布匹配蒸馏+扩散判别器实现少步高保真生成。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体参数量、数据规模和基线对比指标，仅说明构建了大规模多模态音频数据集支撑训练。
summary.authors_note: 作者团队含微软亚洲研究院Xu Tan、香港科技大学Qifeng Chen、上海交通大学等机构研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Flexible multimodal-conditional audio/music generation faces three bottlenecks: lack of a unified modeling framework, shortage of high-quality training data, and prohibitive inference cost of multi-step diffusion sampling.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a unified anything-to-audio generation framework paired with a large-scale training dataset, combining methodological and data contributions in multimodal generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Follows a teacher-student distillation paradigm: the teacher AudioX-Base uses a Multimodal Diffusion Transformer with a Multimodal Adaptive Fusion module to align text/video/audio conditions; the student AudioX-Turbo achieves few-step high-fidelity generation via flow-matching-adapted Distribution Matching Distillation plus a diffusion-based discriminator.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report parameter count, dataset size or quantitative baseline comparisons, only mentions a large-scale multimodal audio dataset is built to support training.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include researchers from Microsoft Research Asia (Xu Tan), Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Qifeng Chen), and Shanghai Jiao Tong University.

recommendation.zh: 多模态音频生成的工程化整合工作，数据配比和蒸馏配方可作弱参考，与LLM基座预训练无直接关联。
recommendation.en: An engineering integration work for multimodal audio generation; its data mixture and distillation recipe offer weak reference, with no direct relevance to LLM foundation pretraining.

institutions: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: The Geometry of Phase Transitions in Generative Dynamics via Projection Caustics
paper.abstract: Continuous-state generative samplers, including diffusion and flow-matching models, evolve through continuous reverse-time dynamics, yet their samples often undergo abrupt qualitative changes: trajectories commit to modes, semantic alternatives collapse, and small perturbations in narrow time windows can produce large downstream effects. This paper develops a geometric account of such phase-transition-like behaviour. We view denoising as gradient descent on a free energy landscape and show that

summary.core_problem: 解释 diffusion 和 flow-matching 采样轨迹中为何会出现突然的模式承诺、语义分支坍缩和窄时间窗敏感性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成动力学的几何分析和诊断工具：它把连续反向采样中的突变现象联系到 projection caustics，并提出可定位敏感时间窗的 Critical Boundary Detector；对研究 diffusion LM 或统一 AR+diffusion 建模的人有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把 denoising 看作自由能景观上的梯度下降，认为当到数据支撑集的最近点投影不再唯一时，会形成 projection caustics，从而产生相变式行为。基于这个几何视角，提出 CBD，用 score direction instability 作为实用诊断信号，定位 mode commitment 和可控干预窗口。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 toy models、标准 diffusion models 和 latent text-to-image diffusion models。结果显示 CBD 能定位模式承诺阶段、预测对干预敏感的时间窗，并支持在几何敏感区域进行 targeted control。摘要未给出具体模型规模或量化提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper explains why continuous diffusion and flow-matching samplers can show abrupt mode commitment, semantic collapse, and narrow intervention-sensitive time windows.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a geometric account of generative dynamics plus a diagnostic tool. It is indirectly relevant to pretraining researchers interested in diffusion language models or hybrid AR-diffusion generation, but the experiments are mainly continuous and image-generation oriented.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors view denoising as gradient descent on a free-energy landscape and attribute sharp transitions to projection caustics, where nearest-point projection onto the data support becomes non-unique. They introduce the Critical Boundary Detector, which diagnoses score-direction instability and identifies sensitive regions along the trajectory.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments on toy settings, standard diffusion models, and latent text-to-image diffusion models. CBD localizes mode-commitment events, predicts intervention-sensitive windows, and supports targeted control in geometrically sensitive regions. The abstract does not provide model scale or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 作为 diffusion dynamics 直觉材料看摘要和 CBD 图即可；离离散 LM 还有距离，不应直接外推到 MDLM/LLaDA。
recommendation.en: Use it as intuition for diffusion dynamics and skim the CBD figures; do not directly transfer the claims to MDLM or LLaDA-style discrete LMs.

paper.title: Itô maps for any-step SDEs
paper.abstract: Recent one-step generative models accelerate sampling by learning deterministic flow maps of the underlying dynamics. These methods rely on learning from ordinary differential equations, leaving open how to define an exact distillation procedure for stochastic dynamics. We introduce the Itô map, an any-step stochastic flow map that takes an intermediate state and Brownian path and predicts future states in a single pass. The Itô map formulation yields novel estimators for inference-time control

summary.core_problem: 如何为随机动力学（SDEs）定义一种精确的蒸馏过程，以实现任意步长的随机流映射？
summary.importance: 提出了Itô map，这是一种任意步长的随机流映射，能够单次预测未来状态，为推理时控制和后验采样提供了新的、可微的估计器，扩展了生成模型的采样和控制能力。
summary.technical_approach: 引入Itô map，它接受中间状态和布朗路径，并在单次传递中预测未来状态。这种公式为推理时控制产生了新的估计器，提供了对后验样本的廉价、可微的访问。
summary.experiments: 在合成和图像生成基准测试中，Itô maps从固定的中间状态产生了多样化、有条件有效的端点样本，并支持强大的转向（steering）性能。
summary.authors_note: Michael S. Albergo (NYU / Flatiron Institute) 等人参与，该团队在 Flow Matching 和随机生成模型方面有深厚积累。

summary_en.core_problem: How to define an exact distillation procedure for stochastic dynamics (SDEs) to enable any-step stochastic flow mapping?
summary_en.importance: Introduces the Itô map, an any-step stochastic flow map that predicts future states in a single pass, providing novel, differentiable estimators for inference-time control and posterior sampling, expanding the sampling and control capabilities of generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the Itô map, which takes an intermediate state and a Brownian path and predicts future states in a single pass. This formulation yields novel estimators for inference-time control by providing cheap, differentiable access to posterior samples.
summary_en.experiments: Empirically, Itô maps produce diverse, conditionally valid endpoint samples from fixed intermediate states and support strong steering performance on synthetic and image-generation benchmarks.
summary_en.authors_note: Co-authored by Michael S. Albergo (NYU / Flatiron Institute), whose team has deep expertise in Flow Matching and stochastic generative models.

recommendation.zh: 将 Flow Matching 的单步蒸馏扩展到了随机动力学（SDE），提出了 Itô map，对于关注 Diffusion/Flow 语言建模范式演进的研究员有启发，值得看其数学构造。
recommendation.en: Extends one-step distillation of Flow Matching to stochastic dynamics (SDEs) with the proposed Itô map; inspiring for researchers tracking the evolution of Diffusion/Flow language modeling paradigms, worth checking its mathematical formulation.

paper.title: Speech Meets ELF: Audio Conditional Continuous-Target Diffusion for Speech Recognition and Translation
paper.abstract: Speech-to-text (S2T) systems for recognition (ASR) and translation (S2TT) typically generate discrete text tokens. In contrast, continuous-target language modelling performs generation in a continuous space, yet its potential for S2T remains unexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose ELF-S2T, an audio-conditioned continuous-target generative model for S2T. Built upon the pre-trained Embedded Language Flows (ELF) backbone, ELF-S2T processes speech via a frozen Whisper encoder and a single linear

summary.core_problem: 研究连续目标语言模型是否能用于语音到文本任务，包括 ASR 和语音翻译，而不是只生成离散文本 token。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是方法迁移和跨模态建模探索。它把 Embedded Language Flows 这类连续空间文本生成模型接到语音条件上，对统一音频-文本建模有一定参考价值；但任务仍主要落在 ASR/S2TT 下游，离基座预训练方法论还有距离。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ELF-S2T：使用预训练 ELF 作为连续目标生成骨干，用冻结的 Whisper encoder 提取语音表示，再通过单层线性 projector 作为条件前缀接入 noisy text latent，进行 flow-matching denoising。训练时加入 audio forcing，避免模型只依赖预训练文本上下文；推理时用 classifier-free guidance 放大音频条件。
summary.experiments: 在 LibriSpeech 和 CoVoST2 上评估 ASR 与 S2TT，报告结果达到有竞争力的性能。摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据量、具体 baseline 数值或提升幅度；另有错误分析指出 ASR 和 S2TT 的表面错误形态相似，但成因可能不同。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether continuous-target language modeling can be used for speech-to-text tasks such as ASR and speech translation, instead of generating discrete text tokens directly.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a method transfer and a multimodal modeling probe. It connects an Embedded Language Flows-style continuous text generator to speech conditioning, which is relevant to audio-text unification, but the empirical target remains mostly downstream ASR/S2TT rather than foundation pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: ELF-S2T uses a pretrained ELF backbone for continuous-target generation, a frozen Whisper encoder for speech features, and a single linear projector to prepend audio conditions to noisy text latents for flow-matching denoising. Audio forcing is used during training to reduce over-reliance on text context, and classifier-free guidance strengthens the audio condition at inference time.
summary_en.experiments: The model is evaluated on LibriSpeech and CoVoST2 for ASR and S2TT, with competitive performance reported. The provided abstract does not specify parameter counts, training-data scale, exact baselines, or numerical gains. The paper also includes error analysis suggesting that similar-looking ASR and S2TT errors may arise from different causes.

recommendation.zh: 可看作 ELF/flow 文本模型接入语音条件的 sanity check；读方法图和错误分析即可，不必按 ASR 论文深读。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a sanity check for conditioning an ELF/flow text model on speech; read the method diagram and error analysis, not the full ASR setup.

paper.title: Mean Flow Distillation: Robust and Stable Distillation for Flow Matching Models
paper.abstract: Flow Matching models have demonstrated strong performance across a wide range of generative tasks. However, their reliance on ODE-based iterative sampling incurs substantial computational overhead in inference, which limits their applicability in real-time scenes.
