While distillation is a promising solution, existing approaches largely borrow from diffusion-based score matching, often failing to exploit the intrinsic geometric structure of flows and suffering from training instability, high varia

summary.core_problem: Flow Matching模型依赖ODE迭代采样导致推理计算开销大，现有蒸馏方法借用扩散的VSD技术存在训练不稳定、高方差和生成质量下降问题
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出Mean Flow Distillation(MFD)，专门适配Flow Matching的几何结构，证明了Mean Flow Matching定理
summary.technical_approach: MFD作为时域低通滤波器抑制VSD中的高频优化噪声，同时保证全局轨迹一致性；证明匹配期望平均速度足以恢复最优学生轨迹；提供理论分析和算法设计
summary.experiments: 在多个生成任务上对比VSD等现有蒸馏方法，验证训练稳定性和生成质量的提升

summary_en.core_problem: Flow Matching models suffer from high inference computational cost due to ODE iterative sampling; existing distillation methods borrowed from diffusion VSD have training instability, high variance, and quality degradation
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: Mean Flow Distillation (MFD) tailored to flow geometry, with theoretical proof of Mean Flow Matching Theorem
summary_en.technical_approach: MFD acts as temporal low-pass filter suppressing high-frequency optimization noise in VSD while ensuring global trajectory consistency; proves matching expected average velocities suffices to recover optimal student trajectory
summary_en.experiments: Compares against VSD and other distillation methods across generative tasks, validating training stability and generation quality improvements

recommendation.zh: Flow Matching蒸馏的理论工作，对图像生成有意义，但对LLM文本建模范式启发有限，仅作为文献备查
recommendation.en: Theoretical work on Flow Matching distillation, relevant for generative modeling but limited LLM pretraining insight; keep as literature reference

paper.title: Flow-DPPO: Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization for Flow Matching Models
paper.abstract: Recent work has demonstrated that online reinforcement learning (RL) can substantially improve the quality and alignment of flow matching models for image and video generation. Methods such as Flow-GRPO and CPS cast the denoising process as a Markov Decision Process and apply PPO-style ratio clipping to enforce a trust region. However, we argue that ratio clipping is structurally ill-suited for flow models: the probability ratio between new and old policies is a noisy, single-sample estimate of

summary.core_problem: 改进 flow matching 图像和视频生成模型的在线 RL 优化，避免 PPO ratio clipping 在连续去噪轨迹中产生不稳定或错误的 trust region 约束。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型后训练方法改进。它不直接推进文本 LLM 预训练，但对“把生成过程视为 MDP 并用 RL 调生成模型”的接口有参考价值，尤其是 trust region 约束如何利用模型分布结构来做得更干净。
summary.technical_approach: Flow-DPPO 将 Flow-GRPO、CPS 一类方法中的 PPO ratio clipping 替换为 divergence proximal constraint。核心观察是 flow model 每一步 policy 可写成 Gaussian，因此新旧 policy 的 KL divergence 可以精确且低成本计算。方法进一步使用 asymmetric divergence mask：在超出约束的方向阻断梯度，在允许区域内保留优化信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体图像/视频模型规模、数据集、奖励模型、baseline 数量或提升幅度。可确认的 baseline 包括 Flow-GRPO 和 CPS，目标是提升 flow matching 生成模型的质量与对齐。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper improves online RL for flow-matching image and video generators by replacing noisy PPO ratio clipping with a better-specified trust-region constraint.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training method for generative flow models. It is not directly about text LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to the broader interface between generative modeling and RL-based alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Flow-DPPO replaces PPO-style ratio clipping used by methods such as Flow-GRPO and CPS with a divergence proximal constraint. The key observation is that each per-step policy in a flow model is Gaussian, so the KL divergence between old and new policies can be computed exactly and cheaply. An asymmetric divergence mask blocks gradients only when the update violates the desired trust region.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, reward models, or quantitative gains. It positions Flow-GRPO and CPS as the main baselines and targets quality/alignment improvements for image and video flow-matching models.

recommendation.zh: 只看 KL 约束替代 ratio clipping 的推导；对文本预训练不直接有用，但可借鉴到生成模型 RL 接口。
recommendation.en: Read only the KL-vs-ratio-clipping argument; it is not directly useful for text pretraining, but the RL interface design is transferable.

paper.title: Learning to Solve Generative ODEs Beyond the Linear Span
paper.abstract: Diffusion and flow generative models sample by integrating a learned ODE, but high quality still requires many sequential model evaluations. Solver learning reduces this cost by adapting scalar coefficients, timesteps, or both, while keeping the backbone model fixed. In this work, we identify a structural bottleneck in this update family: each step remains span-limited. Since the scalar-coefficient update lies in the span of buffered velocity evaluations, it can fit only the in-span component wh

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散和流生成模型中，学习求解器（solver learning）仅限于在缓冲速度评估的线性张成空间内更新，导致无法拟合张成空间外残差的问题。
summary.importance: 指出了现有 ODE 求解器学习方法的一个结构性瓶颈，并提出了一种轻量级的神经求解器 SpanLift 来突破这一限制，提升了生成质量。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SpanLift，在标量系数更新的基础上增加了一个空间残差算子。它保持固定的基础求解器作为张成空间内的先验，并在状态和速度缓冲区上学习一个空间残差算子。该算子通过端点教师匹配进行训练，保留了预训练的主干网络，且不增加模型 NFE（网络函数评估次数）。
summary.experiments: 经验表明，学习到的校正可以跨模型转移。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the limitation in solver learning for diffusion and flow models where updates are confined to the linear span of buffered velocity evaluations, leaving out-of-span residuals unreachable.
summary_en.importance: Identifies a structural bottleneck in existing ODE solver learning and proposes SpanLift, a lightweight neural solver to overcome this limitation and improve generation quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes SpanLift, which augments scalar-coefficient updates with a spatial residual operator. It keeps a fixed base solver as an in-span prior and learns a spatial residual operator over the state and velocity buffer. Trained via endpoint teacher matching, it preserves the pretrained backbone and adds no model NFEs.
summary_en.experiments: Empirically shows that the learned correction transfers across models.

recommendation.zh: 针对 Diffusion/Flow 模型的 ODE 求解器优化，指出了线性张成空间的局限并提出改进，对关注连续时间生成范式的研究员有一定参考价值，但非核心 LLM 预训练内容。
recommendation.en: Optimizes ODE solvers for Diffusion/Flow models by addressing linear span limitations; relevant for continuous-time generative modeling but peripheral to core LLM pretraining.

paper.title: Self-Consistent Generative Paths via Admissible Random Variational Transport
paper.abstract: Modern generative models often define an entire probability path from a simple prior to the data law, rather than only an endpoint map. Diffusion models follow stochastic denoising paths, flow matching learns transport fields, consistency and distillation methods compress paths into one or a few steps, adversarial models match terminal distributions, and VAEs generate through latent kernels. Existing unifying views mainly describe how such paths are constructed. We study a complementary question

summary.core_problem: 现代生成模型常定义一整条从先验到数据分布的概率路径，但缺少一个统一标准来判断这条生成路径何时是自洽的。
summary.importance: 贡献是生成建模的统一理论框架，试图把 diffusion、flow matching、consistency/distillation、GAN、VAE 等路径式生成方法放进“self-consistent generative path”的共同语言里。对 LLM 预训练不是直接方法，但对离散 diffusion LM、flow-based LM 这类新范式有概念层面的启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把自洽生成路径定义为 admissible local variational transport corrections 的随机不动点。局部修正由随机 variational transport operator 给出，组合 divergence/geometry 项、energy 项和结构约束。该框架包含随机正则化 OT proximal step，也允许非 OT divergence、随机能量和约束，从而统一描述多类生成路径。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体实验规模、数据集或与主流生成模型的定量对比，更像理论建模论文。实验部分大概率用于说明框架可覆盖若干现有生成范式，而不是在标准 benchmark 上给出强经验结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks when a probability path used by a generative model should be considered self-consistent, rather than merely how such a path is constructed.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a unifying theoretical framework for path-based generative modeling, covering diffusion, flow matching, consistency/distillation, GANs, and VAEs under a common notion of self-consistent generative paths. This is not directly a pretraining recipe, but it may be conceptually useful for diffusion LM and flow-based LM work.
summary_en.technical_approach: A self-consistent generative path is defined as a random fixed point of admissible local variational transport corrections. Each local correction is represented by a random variational transport operator combining a divergence or geometry term, an energy term, and a structural constraint. The framework includes regularized OT proximal steps as a special case while allowing broader non-OT divergences and stochastic energies.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract provides no concrete scale, datasets, or strong quantitative comparisons, so this appears primarily theoretical. The empirical part is likely illustrative rather than a decisive benchmark study.

recommendation.zh: 偏统一理论，不会直接改你的训练 recipe；若你在看 diffusion/flow LM，只读定义和 special cases，别期待有干净的大规模实证。
recommendation.en: This is mostly unifying theory, not something that will change your training recipe; read the definitions and special cases if you work on diffusion/flow LMs, but do not expect clean large-scale evidence.

paper.title: dots.tts Technical Report
paper.abstract: We present dots.tts, a 2B-parameter continuous autoregressive text-to-speech (TTS) foundation model that models speech in a continuous latent space. Compared with existing continuous autoregressive models, our key innovations are threefold. First, we train an AudioVAE with multiple objectives to build a semantically structured and prediction-friendly continuous speech space. Second, we use full-history conditioning in the flow-matching head to preserve long-range consistency and reduce drift dur

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决连续潜空间自回归 TTS 的长程误差累积问题：连续 latent 没有离散 codec 的量化“纠错”缓冲，小的预测偏差会被解码器保留，并在后续 AR 条件中持续放大。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的启发主要在语音 LM 的建模范式。dots.tts 不是把语音压成离散 token 后套用文本 LM，而是保留连续表示，并用 AR backbone 加 flow-matching head 建模每一步的连续分布。这条路线绕开了离散语音 tokenizer 的表达上限，尤其适合把中性朗读、情感、副语言、歌唱和一般音频放进同一个生成分布。但代价是训练和解码稳定性更难控制。论文的价值在于给出了一套较完整的连续 AR TTS recipe：连续 AudioVAE、长程 LM、局部 flow 渲染、自纠正后训练和少步蒸馏。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由三部分组成。第一，训练一个 AudioVAE 作为连续语音 tokenizer。它先做重建导向训练，再加入多任务下游目标和 WavLM 表征对齐损失，使 latent 同时具备声学可还原性、语义结构和可预测性。这样做的目的不是只追求 codec 重建质量，而是让后续 AR 模型更容易学习。第二，生成模型拆成语义 encoder、LLM backbone 和 AR flow-matching head。LLM 负责长程文本到内容的规划，flow head 负责每个 latent patch 的局部连续声学渲染。论文强调 full-history conditioning，即 flow-matching head 不只看局部窗口，而是使用完整历史条件，以降低长句生成时的漂移。第三，后训练阶段把类似 SOAR 的 reward-free self-correction 用到 flow head 上，让声学 DiT 暴露在自己推理时产生的 off-trajectory 错误上，不依赖外部 reward model 或 teacher。推理侧再用 MeanFlow distillation 把 flow ODE 压到 2 到 4 次函数评估，以服务实时和流式 TTS。
summary.experiments: 模型规模为 2B 参数，训练数据为 1.5M 小时多语种语音。论文报告 dots.tts 在 Seed-TTS-Eval 上取得较好的稳定性和零样本 voice cloning 质量，在 MiniMax 24 语种多语测试集上平均 speaker similarity 领先，并在 EmergentTTS-Eval 与 CV3-Eval 上保持竞争力；这些评测覆盖稳定性、说话人相似度、自然度、韵律、副语言和多语覆盖。效率方面，模型按 latent-patch 级因果结构设计，支持文本规划和音频 latent 增量生成，也支持 1T1A interleaved dual-stream inference。MeanFlow 蒸馏后，plain mode 首包延迟为 85 ms，RTF 为 0.231；interleaved streaming mode 首包延迟为 54 ms，RTF 为 0.245。给定材料中没有完整消融表，但从方法描述看，关键消融应集中在 AudioVAE 的语义对齐目标、flow head 的 full-history conditioning、自纠正后训练和 MeanFlow 蒸馏步数。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 40 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对离散 AR、NAR flow/diffusion、连续 AR 的问题拆分，重点理解为什么连续 latent 的主要瓶颈是长程误差累积。然后看方法部分中 AudioVAE 的训练目标、LLM 与 flow head 的职责划分、full-history conditioning 的实现细节。实验部分优先看 Seed-TTS-Eval、MiniMax multilingual、EmergentTTS-Eval、CV3-Eval 的对比表，以及 Section 3.4 的效率结果。若关注预训练 recipe，最该深挖的是连续 tokenizer 的目标设计和 self-corrective alignment：前者决定 latent 是否适合 LM 预测，后者决定连续 AR 是否能承受长 rollout。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the main failure mode of continuous-latent autoregressive TTS: long-range error accumulation. Unlike discrete acoustic tokens, continuous latents do not get snapped back to a valid codec state. Small prediction errors are decoded faithfully and then fed back as future context.
summary_en.importance: The work is useful for speech-language-model pretraining because it studies a native continuous AR formulation rather than reducing speech to discrete codec tokens. This removes part of the expressivity ceiling imposed by discrete tokenizers, especially for expressive speech, paralinguistics, singing, and broader audio-like events. The tradeoff is harder training and rollout stability. The technical report is valuable as a fairly complete recipe for continuous AR TTS: a prediction-friendly AudioVAE, an LM backbone, a flow-matching acoustic head, reward-free self-correction, and low-step flow distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach: dots.tts has three main components. First, it trains an AudioVAE as a continuous speech tokenizer. The VAE is not optimized only for reconstruction; after reconstruction-oriented training, the authors add multitask downstream objectives and a WavLM representation-alignment loss so that the latent space is semantic, reconstructable, and easier for an AR model to predict. Second, generation is decomposed into a semantic encoder, an LLM backbone, and an autoregressive flow-matching head. The LLM handles long-range text-to-content planning, while the flow head renders local acoustic detail for each latent patch. The flow head uses full-history conditioning instead of only local context, which is meant to reduce drift in long utterances. Third, the post-training stage adapts reward-free self-correction, in the spirit of SOAR, to the flow head. The acoustic DiT is trained on its own off-trajectory inference errors without requiring a reward model or an external teacher. For deployment, MeanFlow distillation reduces the flow ODE to 2 to 4 function evaluations.
summary_en.experiments: The model has 2B parameters and is trained on 1.5M hours of multilingual speech. The report claims strong stability and zero-shot voice-cloning quality on Seed-TTS-Eval, leading average speaker similarity on the 24-language MiniMax multilingual test set, and competitive results on EmergentTTS-Eval and CV3-Eval. These benchmarks cover stability, speaker similarity, naturalness, prosody, paralinguistics, and multilingual coverage. The model is causal at the latent-patch level and supports incremental text planning and audio-latent emission, including 1T1A interleaved dual-stream inference. After MeanFlow distillation, the reported first-packet latency is 85 ms with RTF 0.231 in plain mode, and 54 ms with RTF 0.245 in interleaved streaming mode. The provided text does not include full ablation tables, but the important ablations should be the AudioVAE objectives, full-history conditioning, self-corrective alignment, and the number of MeanFlow function evaluations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 to 40 minutes. Start with the introduction, which clearly separates non-autoregressive flow/diffusion TTS, discrete-token AR TTS, and continuous-latent AR TTS. The key conceptual point is why continuous AR generation is more expressive but more exposed to drift. Then read the method sections on AudioVAE training, the separation between the LLM and the flow head, and full-history conditioning. In the experiments, focus on the Seed-TTS-Eval, MiniMax multilingual, EmergentTTS-Eval, and CV3-Eval tables, plus the efficiency section around real-time and interleaved streaming inference. For pretraining-oriented readers, the most useful parts are the continuous tokenizer design and the self-corrective alignment stage, since they directly affect whether continuous speech latents can be modeled reliably by an LM-style backbone.

recommendation.zh: 读 AudioVAE 目标和 full-history flow head 即可；指标好看，但先当 continuous speech latent 的工程信号，不要直接外推到通用 LM。
recommendation.en: Read the AudioVAE objectives and full-history flow head; the numbers are strong, but treat it as an engineering signal for continuous speech latents, not a direct LM recipe.

paper.title: DRIFT: A Residual Flow Adapter for Decoding Continuous Outputs in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Many modern vision-language models (VLMs) build on autoregressive decoding of discrete tokens. While text-based output interfaces enable scalable pretraining and strong zero-shot generalization across diverse tasks, they are poorly suited for problems that require precise continuous outputs, such as localizing temporal boundaries of events or generating robotic control actions. To address this challenge, we propose DRIFT, a general framework for adapting pretrained VLMs to continuous decoding ta

summary.core_problem: 现有基于离散token自回归解码的视觉语言模型（VLM）无法输出精确的连续值，难以适配事件时间边界定位、机器人控制等需要连续输出的任务。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出通用的预训练VLM连续输出适配框架，扩展了VLM的任务适配范围，无需重新预训练主干模型。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DRIFT残差流适配框架，由基础预测器生成目标输出的粗估计，再通过流匹配生成式 refinement 模块迭代优化预测；将全局输出分布建模转化为强先验周围的局部残差分布建模，降低优化难度。
summary.experiments: 在视觉感知和规划两类任务上开展评估，覆盖视觉 grounding 等需要连续输出的场景，论文摘要未披露具体模型参数量和量化提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) built on autoregressive decoding of discrete tokens cannot output precise continuous values, making them unsuitable for tasks requiring continuous outputs such as event temporal boundary localization and robotic control.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposing a general adaptation framework for pretrained VLMs to handle continuous decoding tasks without retraining the backbone model, expanding the task applicability of VLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes DRIFT, a residual flow adapter framework combining a base predictor for coarse target output estimation and a generative refinement module based on flow matching for iterative prediction improvement; transforms global output distribution modeling into localized residual distribution modeling around a strong prior, reducing optimization difficulty.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on both perception and planning tasks including visual grounding requiring continuous outputs; specific model parameter counts and quantitative improvement margins are not disclosed in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 作为VLM适配连续输出的早期探索，仅适合扩展技术视野参考，无预训练相关核心insight，不需要精读。
recommendation.en: An early exploration of adapting VLMs to continuous output tasks, only suitable for expanding technical scope, with no core insights related to pretraining, no need for intensive reading.

paper.title: UniVoice: A Unified Model for Speech and Singing Voice Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-speech (TTS) and singing voice synthesis (SVS) both aim to generate human vocal audio from symbolic inputs, but they impose different requirements on the generation process. Speech generation relies on flexible, language-driven prosody, whereas singing generation requires explicit melody control and accurate rhythmic alignment. This mismatch makes it challenging to train a single model that can generate both natural speech and controllable singing, since melody-related conditions should

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作试图用一个统一模型同时完成语音生成和歌声生成，解决两者在韵律自由度与旋律强约束之间的冲突。
summary.importance: 它属于语音生成方向的方法整合。对 LLM 基座研究员的价值不在 TTS 本身，而在条件因子分解和共享生成骨干的设计：内容、旋律、音色被拆开编码，再送入统一 DiT，这和多模态统一建模里的条件解耦思路相通。
summary.technical_approach: UniVoice 基于 conditional flow matching。作者不使用单一混合条件表示，而是把条件分解为 content、melody、timbre 三部分，分别用适合模态的编码器建模，再由共享的 Diffusion Transformer 生成音频。歌声侧用 MIDI note sequence 提供旋律控制；语音侧则不让 melody 条件过度约束 prosody，从而兼顾 speech 的自然性与 singing 的可控性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、训练语料规模和具体 baseline。实验目标应是同时验证 speech 与 singing 两个任务上的自然度、可控性和统一建模能力。由于缺少离散 tokenizer、统一 token space 或语言建模式建模细节，这篇更偏生成系统设计，而不是 AudioLM/VALL-E 那类对基座预训练更直接的工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to build a single model for both speech generation and singing voice generation, addressing the mismatch between flexible speech prosody and strongly constrained melody control in singing.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a speech-generation unification paper. Its relevance to foundation-model researchers is not TTS per se, but the factorized conditioning design: content, melody, and timbre are encoded separately and fed into a shared DiT backbone, which echoes broader ideas in unified multimodal modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: UniVoice is based on conditional flow matching. Instead of a single undifferentiated conditioning representation, it factorizes conditions into content, melody, and timbre, each handled by a modality-appropriate encoder and consumed by a shared Diffusion Transformer. For singing, melody is represented by MIDI note sequences; for speech, melody should not overconstrain prosody, allowing natural speech generation while preserving singing controllability.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training data scale, or exact baselines. The likely evaluation targets are naturalness, controllability, and unified performance across both speech and singing. Because the paper does not appear to center on discrete tokenization, unified token spaces, or language-model-style audio modeling, it is more of a generation-system design than an AudioLM/VALL-E-style foundation-model contribution.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心统一生成条件接口，可以看它怎么拆 content/melody/timbre；但它离“把语音当 LM 建”还远，正文不必细读。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick look for how it factorizes content, melody, and timbre in a shared generator, but it is still far from the 'audio as LM' line, so no need to read deeply.

paper.title: Are we really tilting? The mechanics of reward guidance in flow and diffusion models
paper.abstract: Reward guidance algorithms steer a learned generative process toward the reward-tilted measure at inference time. While empirically powerful, these methods are prone to reward hacking: the guided model over-optimizes the reward at the cost of fidelity to the learned distribution. Prior work has attributed this to the complexity of neural reward functions or implicit biases in diffusion training, but its fundamental origins remain poorly understood. We show that reward hacking arises from an appr

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 reward-guided flow / diffusion 为什么没有真正采到 reward-tilted distribution，而是经常出现 reward hacking。核心结论是：问题不一定来自复杂 reward 模型或 diffusion 训练偏差，有限粒子的 Doob h-function plug-in 估计本身就会引入系统性偏差。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在 LLM 训练 recipe，而在“用奖励信号改写生成分布”的机制理解。它把 reward guidance 中的 reward hacking 拆成可分析的统计误差问题，说明即使基础分布、reward、动力学都很简单，近似的 guidance 也会把样本推向错误区域。这对 diffusion LM、flow-based LM、RL-style generation、best-of-n sampling、test-time search 都有启发：奖励信号的使用方式可能比 reward 模型本身更早地产生偏差。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从 stochastic interpolants 和 Doob h-transform 出发。理想情况下，若已知 h_t(x)=E[exp(lambda r(X_1)) | X_t=x]，就可以通过修改 drift，使终端分布精确变成 rho_1(x) exp(lambda r(x)) 归一化后的 reward tilt。实际方法通常无法计算这个条件期望，只能从 p(X_1 | X_t=x) 采 k 个粒子，用有限样本平均近似 h_t。论文分析的重点就是这个 plug-in estimator。作者在 Gaussian 和 Gaussian mixture 目标上做闭式分析，分离出两个失败模式：在单个 mode 内，有限粒子估计会导致过度集中和均值 overshoot；在多 mode 情况下，局部条件采样很难发现远处高 reward mode，因此 guidance 缺少正确重加权不同 mode 的机制。为缓解第一个问题，论文提出一个闭式的 damped reward schedule lambda_t，降低后期 guidance 的过强拉动；为处理 mode selection，论文解释 best-of-n 的作用不是修正 drift，而是通过多次采样增加命中高 reward mode 的机会。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Gaussian mixture、二维 checkerboard 和 FLUX.1 文生图。Gaussian / Gaussian mixture 部分用于验证理论预测：普通 plug-in guidance 会在 mode 内过度优化 reward，并且不能可靠选择远距离高 reward mode；damped lambda_t 能减轻 within-mode reward hacking；best-of-n 更接近承担跨 mode 选择的角色。FLUX.1 实验用于展示这个机制在实际 text-to-image guidance 中也有可见影响：单纯增大 guidance scale 会提高 reward 指标但损伤 fidelity，而 damping 加 best-of-n 可以在 reward 和样本质量之间给出更稳的折中。提供的正文片段没有给出完整数值表，适合把实验作为机制验证而非最终性能比较来读。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。重点看 Background 中 Doob h-transform 和有限粒子 h-function 估计的定义，然后看 Gaussian 与 Gaussian mixture 的闭式推导。图 2 是理解整篇论文的入口：base target、analytic reward tilting、practical guidance、damping + best-of-n 的对比很清楚。实验部分优先看 Gaussian mixture 和 FLUX.1，关注 damping schedule 改的是什么、best-of-n 没有改什么。若关心 diffusion LM 或 RL-guided generation，可以深挖它对“奖励倾斜分布”和“实际采样分布”差距的刻画。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why reward-guided flow and diffusion models often fail to sample from the intended reward-tilted distribution and instead show reward hacking. Its main point is that the failure can arise from the finite-particle plug-in approximation of the Doob h-function, even in simple Gaussian settings.
summary_en.importance: The value for foundation-model pretraining research is conceptual rather than recipe-level. It gives a clean mechanism for how reward signals distort a generative distribution when the guidance estimator is biased. This matters for diffusion language models, flow-based language models, RL-guided generation, best-of-n sampling, and test-time search: the approximation used to inject reward can introduce distributional errors before one even considers neural reward-model misspecification.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis is built around stochastic interpolants and the Doob h-transform. If h_t(x)=E[exp(lambda r(X_1)) | X_t=x] were available, modifying the drift by the corresponding h-transform would produce exact samples from the reward-tilted terminal law. Practical methods approximate h_t with k samples from the conditional endpoint distribution p(X_1 | X_t=x). The paper studies this plug-in estimator directly. In Gaussian targets, it derives how finite-particle estimation causes within-mode overconcentration and mean overshoot. In Gaussian mixtures, it shows that local conditional sampling has no reliable mechanism for reweighting distant high-reward modes. The proposed mitigation is a closed-form damped reward schedule lambda_t for reducing within-mode over-optimization, while best-of-n sampling is interpreted as a separate mechanism for mode selection rather than as a fix to the drift estimator.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical section uses Gaussian mixtures, a 2D checkerboard distribution, and FLUX.1 text-to-image generation. The synthetic experiments validate the predicted failure modes: standard plug-in guidance over-optimizes reward within a mode and struggles to select far-away high-reward modes. The damped schedule reduces within-mode reward hacking, while best-of-n mainly improves the chance of finding a better mode. The FLUX.1 experiments show the same tradeoff in a realistic generator: increasing guidance can raise reward metrics while reducing fidelity, and damping plus best-of-n gives a more controlled tradeoff. The provided text does not include the full numerical tables, so the results are best read as mechanistic evidence rather than as a leaderboard-style comparison.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–35 minutes. Start with the background on the Doob h-transform and the finite-particle h-function estimator. Then read the closed-form Gaussian and Gaussian-mixture analyses, since that is where the main contribution lies. Figure 2 is the fastest way to understand the contrast between analytic tilting, practical guidance, and the proposed damping plus best-of-n strategy. For readers working on diffusion LMs or reward-guided generation, the useful part is the gap between the ideal tilted law and the actual sampling law induced by estimator bias.

recommendation.zh: 核心结论清晰解释了奖励引导的reward hacking根源，阻尼策略可直接复现用于diffusion LM的推理引导消融实验
recommendation.en: Its core conclusions clearly explain the root of reward hacking in reward guidance; the damping schedule can be directly reproduced for diffusion LM inference guidance ablation experiments

paper.title: MT-EditFlow: Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Image Editing with Flow Matching
paper.abstract: Recent breakthroughs in instruction-based image editing have captured significant attention, as models are now capable of handling real-world editing demands with the practicality required by everyday users. However, editing models trained primarily for single-turn edits often break down in multi-turn editing--the natural interactive setting where a user iteratively refines an image based on the model's own previous outputs. This failure stems from the all-or-nothing requirement, where a single

summary.core_problem: 解决基于指令的图像编辑模型在多轮交互编辑中容易出现的错误累积和级联失败问题。
summary.importance: 将强化学习（RL）引入多轮图像编辑，提出了一种基于流匹配（Flow Matching）的RL框架，缓解了多轮编辑中的曝光偏差。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MT-EditFlow框架，将多轮视角与多奖励公式相结合，为GRPO和基于NFT的强化学习方法提供统一结构，优化序列图像编辑的奖励信号。
summary.experiments: 系统分析了多轮编辑中的错误传播问题，并验证了MT-EditFlow在多轮编辑场景下的有效性。
summary.authors_note: 来自UC、UT Austin等机构，Mingyuan Zhou、Ying Nian Wu等知名学者参与。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the issues of error accumulation and cascading failures in instruction-based image editing models during multi-turn interactive editing.
summary_en.importance: Introduces Reinforcement Learning (RL) to multi-turn image editing, proposing a Flow Matching-based RL framework to mitigate exposure bias in multi-turn editing.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the MT-EditFlow framework, integrating a multi-turn perspective with a multi-reward formulation to provide a unified structure for GRPO and NFT-based RL methods, optimizing reward signals for sequential image editing.
summary_en.experiments: Systematically analyzes error propagation in multi-turn editing and validates the effectiveness of MT-EditFlow in multi-turn editing scenarios.
summary_en.authors_note: From UC, UT Austin, etc., involving notable scholars like Mingyuan Zhou and Ying Nian Wu.

recommendation.zh: 将RL（GRPO等）应用于多轮图像编辑（Flow Matching），对关注多模态RL或Flow Matching后训练的研究员有一定参考价值，但核心仍是图像编辑。
recommendation.en: Applies RL (e.g., GRPO) to multi-turn image editing (Flow Matching), offering some reference value for researchers interested in multimodal RL or Flow Matching post-training, though the core remains image editing.

institutions: natural human-AI collaboration in visual content creation

paper.title: Initialization is Half the Battle: Generating Diverse Images from a Guidance Potential Posterior
paper.abstract: Despite the remarkable fidelity of generative models, they frequently suffer from mode collapse. Existing strategies for enhancing diversity predominantly focus on intervening during the generation trajectory. We identify a critical oversight that the standard Gaussian initialization often causes trajectories to collapse into dominant modes because it is agnostic to the guidance potential landscape. In this work, we formulate selecting the initial noise from a guidance potential posterior, which

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散模型和 flow matching 模型在采样时容易落入主导模式、生成多样性不足的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是生成模型推理阶段的多样性控制方法：把初始化噪声视为可优化对象，而不是只在去噪轨迹中调 guidance；对文本 LLM 预训练无直接作用，但对多模态生成的采样机制有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Diversity-inducing Initialization，核心假设是标准 Gaussian 初始化与 guidance potential landscape 无关，会把轨迹送入高概率但低多样性的吸引域。方法将初始噪声采样表述为 guidance potential posterior，并用 Langevin dynamics 在初始化空间中移动噪声，使其远离 collapse 区域，同时通过先验约束保持在有效数据流形附近。方法是 inference-time 插件，可用于 diffusion 和 flow matching。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在扩散模型和 flow matching 模型上做了广泛实验，显示多样性提升，同时保持生成质量；未给出具体模型规模、数据集、baseline 或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles mode collapse and insufficient sample diversity in diffusion and flow-matching generative models.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an inference-time diversity mechanism that treats initialization as a controllable variable, rather than only intervening along the denoising trajectory. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to sampling behavior in multimodal generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, Diversity-inducing Initialization, argues that standard Gaussian initialization is blind to the guidance potential landscape and can route trajectories into dominant modes. It formulates initial noise selection as sampling from a guidance-potential posterior and uses Langevin dynamics to move initial noise away from collapsing regions while keeping it anchored to the valid data manifold. It is designed as a plug-in inference-time method for both diffusion and flow-matching models.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive experiments across diffusion and flow-matching models, with improved diversity while preserving fidelity. It does not provide concrete model scale, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 想做生成采样的人看方法定义即可；对 LLM pretrain 不改 prior，但“初始化分布也会决定 mode coverage”这个点值得记住。
recommendation.en: Read the method definition if you work on generative sampling; it does not change LLM-pretraining priors, but the initialization-versus-mode-coverage point is worth noting.

paper.title: JenBridge: Adaptive Long-Form Video Soundtracking across Scene Transitions
paper.abstract: We address the challenge of generating high-fidelity, long-form soundtracks that remain coherent across scene transitions. Existing AI music systems are mainly designed for short, isolated clips and lack mechanisms to ensure narrative continuity. We present JenBridge, a modular and interpretable framework for adaptive long-form video soundtracking that ensures both high-fidelity audio generation and transition naturalness. The core architecture is a Transformer-based generative model trained wit

summary.core_problem: 现有AI音乐系统仅支持短孤立片段生成，无法保证长视频跨场景转场的配乐连贯性
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出模块化可解释的长视频配乐框架，引入自适应转场机制
summary.technical_approach: 基于flow matching目标训练Transformer生成模型，采用两阶段范式：先在大规模文本-音频语料预训练获取音乐先验，再通过双文本-视觉条件适配视频域，加入自适应转态机制
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露完整实验设置与量化指标，核心验证长视频跨场景配乐的保真度与连贯性
summary.authors_note: 来自Cohere团队，无公开知名核心作者背景信息

summary_en.core_problem: Existing AI music systems only support short isolated clip generation, cannot ensure soundtrack coherence across long video scene transitions
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes a modular interpretable long-form video soundtracking framework with adaptive transition mechanism
summary_en.technical_approach: Trains Transformer generative model with flow matching objective, adopts two-stage paradigm: pretrain on large text-audio corpus to get musical priors, then adapt to video domain with dual text-visual conditioning, plus adaptive transition mechanism
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental setup and quantitative metrics are not disclosed in abstract, mainly validates fidelity and coherence of long-form video soundtrack across scene transitions
summary_en.authors_note: From Cohere team, no public notable core author information

recommendation.zh: flow matching做长音频连贯生成的思路可参考，作为多模态生成的增量工作备查，无需读正文
recommendation.en: The flow matching approach for long audio coherence can be referenced as incremental multimodal generation work, no need to read full text

paper.title: DeMaVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Generalizable Deformable Manipulation
paper.abstract: Real-world household robots require Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models that can acquire reusable manipulation skills across diverse objects, task conditions, and household environments. Deformable-object folding is a representative challenge, requiring robots to handle clothing items from random initial states across varying categories, geometries, materials, and scenes. However, existing VLA systems commonly train separate policies for different object categories, while naively mixe

summary.core_problem: 现有VLA系统通常为不同物体类别训练独立策略，混合多任务训练存在任务干扰和性能下降问题，难以实现可泛化的可变形物体操作
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出统一的视觉-语言-动作基础模型用于可变形物体操作，采用流匹配生成连续动作
summary.technical_approach: DeMaVLA采用VLM骨干网络加动作专家的结构，使用流匹配公式化连续动作生成；动作专家通过隔层裁剪Transformer层构建，同时保持与VLM骨干的层级对齐
summary.experiments: 论文未完成展示完整实验结果（摘要被截断），涉及衣物折叠等可变形物体操作任务

summary_en.core_problem: Existing VLA systems train separate policies for different object categories, and naive mixed multi-task training suffers from task interference and performance degradation, limiting generalizable deformable object manipulation
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a unified vision-language-action foundation model for deformable manipulation using flow matching for continuous action generation
summary_en.technical_approach: DeMaVLA uses a VLM backbone with an action expert, formulating continuous action generation via flow matching; the action expert is built by pruning every other Transformer layer while maintaining layer-wise alignment with the VLM backbone
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental results not fully shown in abstract (truncated); involves deformable object manipulation tasks such as clothing folding

recommendation.zh: 机器人操作领域的多模态VLA工作，对LLM预训练研究员的直接价值有限，仅作领域动态了解
recommendation.en: A multimodal VLA work in robotics manipulation, of limited direct value to LLM pretraining researchers — useful only as field dynamics awareness

paper.title: SwanVoice: Expressive Long-Form Zero-Shot Speech Synthesis for Both Monologue and Dialogue
paper.abstract: Zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) has improved substantially for single-speaker synthesis, yet expressive long-form multi-speaker dialogue remains difficult. A common workaround is to synthesize each turn with a monologue TTS model and stitch the outputs together. This adds inference cost and often breaks acoustic consistency, conversational coherence, and affective continuity across turns. Recent dialogue TTS systems have begun to address this setting, but they still struggle to keep expressive co

summary.core_problem: 长篇零样本 TTS 在多人对话中难以同时保持说话人切换、声学一致性、情绪连贯性和单人旁白质量。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是语音生成系统和数据工程。它对语音 tokenizer、低帧率声学表示、flow matching TTS 以及长篇对话式语音建模有参考，但与 LLM 基座预训练的关系较间接。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SwanData-Speech 和 SwanVoice。数据侧从野外音频构建旁白和对话语料，使用 Swan Forced Aligner 做 pause-aware 的词级对齐，并用 RobustMegaTTS3 处理发音困难样本。模型侧支持 1 到 4 个说话人，使用 25 Hz VAE、带停顿符号和拼音替换的原始文本条件，以及 flow-matching 生成。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出训练数据规模、模型参数量、客观指标或主观 MOS 结果。声称相较逐轮合成再拼接的方案，SwanVoice 面向长篇单人和多人对话有更好的连贯性和可控性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 ByteDance 和浙江大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles long-form zero-shot TTS for both monologue and multi-speaker dialogue, where speaker switching, acoustic consistency, affective continuity, and monologue quality are hard to maintain together.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly a speech-generation system and data pipeline. It is relevant to audio tokenization, low-frame-rate acoustic representations, and flow-matching speech generation, but only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: SwanData-Speech builds monologue and dialogue corpora from in-the-wild audio, using a pause-aware word-level forced aligner and RobustMegaTTS3 for pronunciation-hard cases. SwanVoice supports one to four speakers and combines a 25 Hz VAE, raw-text conditioning with pause symbols and pinyin substitution, and a flow-matching generator.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide training scale, model size, MOS scores, or objective metrics. It claims improved long-form coherence and controllable speaker switching compared with synthesizing each turn separately and stitching the outputs.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions are ByteDance and Zhejiang University.

recommendation.zh: 看数据 pipeline 和 25Hz VAE 设计即可；它是强 TTS 工程，不是统一 LM 训练范式。
recommendation.en: Skim the data pipeline and 25 Hz VAE design; this is strong TTS engineering, not a unified LM training paradigm.

paper.title: TokTalk: Expressive Real-time Facial Animation from Audio-LLM Tokens
paper.abstract: Recent advances in Audio-LLMs like GPT-4o have ushered in an era of conversational interaction with language models. Conversational avatars however, still seem robotic in facial expression and conversational flow, in part due to sequential stages of speech recognition, text generation, turn-based text response, speech synthesis, and audio driven facial animation. Based on our insight that audio-tokens produced by current Audio-LLMs carry sufficient information to reconstruct a plausible facial p

summary.core_problem: 绕开ASR→文本→TTS→表情驱动的多阶段管线，直接从Audio-LLM的离散音频token实时生成3D面部动画。
summary.importance: 贡献点主要在“把音频token当中间表征”的系统化落地与数据集；对统一tokenization/跨模态建模有弱相关启发，但不是基座预训练论文。
summary.technical_approach: 构建“音频token→3D面部运动”的配对数据集；用Chunk-based Conditional Flow Matching在token序列上做条件生成；提供轻量适配层以对接不同token化的Audio-LLM，并用chunk处理在延迟与质量间做可调折中。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据规模、定量指标或与强基线的提升幅度；强调实时流式与低额外计算开销。

summary_en.core_problem: Generate expressive real-time 3D facial animation directly from discrete audio tokens produced by Audio-LLMs, bypassing multi-stage ASR/text/TTS pipelines.
summary_en.importance: Main value is a token-to-motion dataset and a practical token-conditioned generation setup; only weakly informative for foundation pretraining (tokenization/unified representations), not a pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: Build an audio-token–to–3D facial motion dataset; train a chunk-based Conditional Flow Matching model conditioned on streaming tokens; add a lightweight adaptation layer to plug into various token-based Audio-LLMs and trade off latency vs quality via chunking.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model/data scale, quantitative metrics, or clean baseline deltas; emphasizes real-time streaming and minimal overhead.

recommendation.zh: 只建议看“audio token是否足够承载表情信息”的设定与数据构造；实验细节在摘要里缺失，别把它当统一预训练结论。
recommendation.en: Skim for the premise and dataset design (whether audio tokens carry enough facial cues); details look under-specified in the abstract—don’t treat it as evidence for unified pretraining.

paper.title: UniSteer: Text-Guided Flow Matching in Activation Space for Versatile LLM Steering
paper.abstract: Activation-based control steers large language models (LLMs) by intervening on their internal representations during inference, and has emerged as an effective paradigm for controlling behaviors such as persona and style. However, existing methods often rely on fixed steering directions or task-specific intervention modules, making them difficult to adapt to fine-grained concepts and compositional constraints. We propose UniSteer, a text-guided activation flow matching model that learns a condit

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM激活引导方法依赖预定义的固定转向向量或任务专属干预模块，每个目标行为需单独拟合，无法通过自然语言灵活指定细粒度控制目标，且多行为约束组合时，不同方向在高维激活空间中易产生干扰。
summary.importance: 将流匹配范式引入LLM内部激活空间的建模，为推理时的模型行为控制提供了无需微调权重的统一框架，同时为激活空间的语义分析、可解释性研究提供了新的工具路径。
summary.technical_approach: 基于流匹配框架学习文本条件的激活空间通用速度场，无需为每个目标行为单独拟合干预策略：1）训练阶段冻结目标LLM，提取选定层的残差流激活，与描述目标行为/约束的自然语言条件配对；用冻结文本编码器编码条件，通过交叉注意力或自适应归一化注入流模型，训练模型学习从随机噪声到对应条件下激活的条件变换。2）推理阶段对输入激活先在源条件下做部分流反转，再在目标条件下前向传输完成编辑；多约束组合直接体现在条件文本中，无需事后融合独立训练的转向组件。3）同一模型可通过比较不同条件下的激活重建能量，实现激活空间的语义分类。
summary.experiments: 公开的全文内容未包含完整实验章节，目前仅披露方法框架与激活引导、激活空间分类两个核心应用场景的设计逻辑。
summary.reading_guide: 优先阅读引言中现有激活引导方法的局限性梳理、方法部分的条件流匹配与流反转推理设计，若后续补充完整实验可重点关注多约束组合场景的效果对比。预计泛读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing activation-based LLM steering methods rely on predefined fixed steering vectors or task-specific intervention modules. Each target behavior requires separate fitting, making them inflexible for fine-grained concept control via natural language, and independent steering directions often interfere with each other in high-dimensional activation space when combining multiple behavioral constraints.
summary_en.importance: It introduces the flow matching paradigm to the modeling of LLM internal activation space, providing a unified, weight-free framework for inference-time model behavior control, and opens a new path for activation space semantic analysis and interpretability research.
summary_en.technical_approach: UniSteer learns a universal text-conditioned velocity field over LLM residual-stream activations via flow matching, eliminating the need for per-behavior intervention fitting: 1) During training, the target LLM is frozen, residual-stream activations from selected layers are extracted and paired with natural language descriptions of target behaviors or constraints. A frozen text encoder encodes conditions, which are injected into the flow model via cross-attention or adaptive normalization to learn the conditional mapping from random noise to activations matching the given condition. 2) At inference, an input activation is first partially inverted under the source condition, then transported forward under the target condition to complete editing; compositional constraints are directly specified in the condition text, with no need for post-hoc fusion of separately trained steering components. 3) The same model can perform activation-space semantic classification by comparing reconstruction energies under different conditions.
summary_en.experiments: The publicly available full text does not include the complete experimental section, only the method framework and design logic for two core application scenarios (activation steering, activation-space classification) are disclosed.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize the review of limitations of existing activation steering methods in the introduction, and the design of conditional flow matching and flow inversion inference in the methodology section. If full experimental results are released later, focus on performance in multi-constraint composition scenarios. Estimated skimming time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 ablation；若通用 velocity field 真能组合控制，会改变对线性 steering vector 的默认假设。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; a robust universal velocity field would weaken the default linear-vector view of activation steering.

paper.title: On-Policy Adversarial Flow Distillation for Autoregressive Video Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video generators are attractive for streaming, long-horizon, and interactive applications, but distilling strong black-box teachers into causal students remains difficult. The student must learn under its own rollout distribution, whereas practical teachers may expose only prompt-conditioned completed videos and may differ in architecture, capacity, temporal design, and sampling schedule. This interface makes supervised fine-tuning off-policy, score-based distillation inapplicable

summary.core_problem: 解决黑盒视频教师模型向因果自回归视频学生模型蒸馏时的分布错配和时间信用分配问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型蒸馏方法创新。它把 on-policy imitation、Bradley-Terry 判别器和 flow-matching 更新结合起来，目标是让自回归视频生成器适配流式、长程和交互式生成场景。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Adversarial Flow Distillation。方法在同一 prompt 下分别查询教师和 rollout 当前学生，用 prompt-paired Bradley-Terry discriminator 估计教师样本与学生样本的差异，再把该差异转成 on-policy advantage，进一步作用到学生自身前向过程上的 flow-matching 更新。它不是简单 SFT，也不依赖教师暴露 score 或内部采样轨迹。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据、baseline 名称和具体指标。可确认的实验设定是异构黑盒教师到自回归视频学生的蒸馏，并强调教师与学生可在架构、容量、时间设计和采样日程上不同。
summary.authors_note: Yang You is known for large-batch optimization work such as LARS/LAMB.

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses distribution mismatch and denoising-time credit assignment when distilling black-box video teachers into causal autoregressive video students.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a distillation method for generative video models. It is relevant because it treats video generation as an on-policy student rollout problem rather than as ordinary supervised imitation from completed teacher samples.
summary_en.technical_approach: Adversarial Flow Distillation queries the teacher and rolls out the current student on matched prompts, trains a prompt-paired Bradley-Terry discriminator to estimate teacher-student discrepancy on clean samples, and converts the resulting on-policy advantage into flow-matching updates on the student's own forward process.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide parameter counts, data scale, baseline details, or metric numbers. The stated experimental setting is heterogeneous black-box teacher-to-student video distillation where teacher and student may differ in architecture, capacity, temporal design, and sampling schedule.
summary_en.authors_note: Yang You is known for large-batch optimization work such as LARS/LAMB.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法框架即可；它对LLM蒸馏的可迁移点是on-policy差异估计，不是视频指标本身。
recommendation.en: Skim the method only; the transferable idea is on-policy discrepancy estimation for distillation, not the video-generation metrics.

paper.title: Geometry-Aware Image Flow Matching
paper.abstract: Recent advances in generative models highlight the power of geometry-aware modeling in manifold-constrained settings. Yet, for natural images, the field remains confined to Euclidean assumptions, failing to exploit the potential of intrinsic geometric structures within the data. In this work, we investigate the geometry of natural images and observe that semantic information is predominantly encoded in directional components, while norm components can be approximated by the global average. This

summary.core_problem: 现有图像 flow matching 多在欧氏空间建模，可能忽略自然图像在方向和范数上的内在几何结构。
summary.importance: 这是图像生成中的几何建模工作。它的价值不在 LLM 直接应用，而在于提出自然图像可在 hypersphere 上建模的经验观察，并把该观察用于 flow matching 目标设计。
summary.technical_approach: 作者观察到语义信息主要存在于方向分量，范数分量可由全局平均近似；这一性质在 RGB 和 latent space 中都成立。基于此提出 Spherical Optimal Transport Flow Matching，使用 angular distance；以及 Spherical Flow Matching，直接约束动力学在球面流形上。
summary.experiments: 摘要称几何感知方法优于欧氏 baseline，但未给出数据集、模型规模、FID 或其他指标数值。实验覆盖 RGB 与 latent space 的图像表示几何分析，并比较球面 flow matching 与欧氏 flow matching。

summary_en.core_problem: Most image flow matching methods operate in Euclidean space, which may ignore intrinsic geometry in natural image representations.
summary_en.importance: This is a geometry-aware image generation paper. Its relevance to base-model research is indirect: it proposes that natural images can be modeled on a hypersphere and modifies flow matching objectives accordingly.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors observe that semantic information is mostly encoded in directional components, while norm components can be approximated by a global average. They introduce Spherical Optimal Transport Flow Matching with angular distance and Spherical Flow Matching with dynamics constrained to the spherical manifold.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that the geometry-aware methods outperform Euclidean baselines, but does not provide dataset names, model sizes, or metric values. The experiments analyze both RGB and latent spaces and compare spherical versus Euclidean flow matching.

recommendation.zh: 作为生成建模几何假设备查即可；若没有大规模 latent diffusion 验证，不必投入太多阅读时间。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference on geometric assumptions in generative modeling; without large-scale latent diffusion evidence, it is not a deep read.

paper.title: Reinforcing Few-step Generators via Reward-Tilted Distribution Matching
paper.abstract: Recent advances in few-step diffusion distillation have enabled efficient image generation, yet aligning these models with human preferences remains challenging. We propose Reward-Tilted Distribution Matching Distillation (RTDMD), a two-stage framework that unifies distribution matching distillation with reward-guided reinforcement learning for few-step flow generators. We show that minimizing the KL divergence to a reward-tilted teacher distribution naturally decomposes into a distribution matc

summary.core_problem: 解决少步 diffusion/flow 生成器在蒸馏后生成很快但难以再按人类偏好对齐的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是图像生成模型的奖励对齐和蒸馏方法改进。它不属于 LLM 预训练，但把 distribution matching distillation 与 reward-guided RL 放在同一个 KL 目标下推导，对理解生成模型对齐目标有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Reward-Tilted Distribution Matching Distillation。核心是把到 reward-tilted teacher distribution 的 KL 最小化分解为 distribution matching 项和 reward maximization 项。第一阶段 AC-DMD 做子区间级分布匹配，并用 consistency regularizer 稳定 fake score model，使其跟踪有限更新下不断移动的 generator distribution。第二阶段联合优化分布匹配和奖励项，奖励部分推导了结合 GRPO 风格信号的 hybrid policy gradient。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明方法面向 few-step flow generators，并与现有少步 diffusion distillation 和偏好对齐方法比较；提供文本未包含具体模型、数据集、奖励模型、步数、FID/CLIP/人评结果或提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology 与 Westlake University；Tianyu Pang 近年有生成模型、鲁棒性和对齐相关工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses preference alignment for few-step diffusion or flow generators, where fast distilled models are hard to further optimize toward human rewards.
summary_en.importance: This is a method contribution for image generation alignment and distillation. It is not LLM pretraining, but the derivation linking distribution matching and reward optimization under a single KL objective is relevant for thinking about generative-model alignment losses.
summary_en.technical_approach: RTDMD minimizes KL to a reward-tilted teacher distribution and decomposes the objective into a distribution-matching term and a reward-maximization term. Stage one introduces AC-DMD with subinterval-wise distribution matching and a consistency regularizer for the fake score model. Stage two jointly optimizes matching and reward, using a hybrid policy-gradient estimator that incorporates GRPO-style signals.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract positions the method for few-step flow generators and compares against existing diffusion distillation and reward-alignment approaches, but the provided text does not include concrete model sizes, datasets, reward models, sampling steps, or metric gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology and Westlake University. Tianyu Pang has worked on generative models, robustness, and alignment-related methods.

recommendation.zh: 读目标函数推导即可；把 DMD 和奖励倾斜写成同一 KL，比图像实验本身更值得记。
recommendation.en: Read the objective derivation only; the useful part is casting DMD and reward tilting under one KL, not the image results.

institutions: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: RobustSpeechFlow: Learning Robust Text-to-Speech Trajectories via Augmentation-based Contrastive Flow Matching
paper.abstract: While flow-matching text-to-speech (TTS) achieves strong zero-shot speaker similarity and naturalness, it remains susceptible to content fidelity issues, particularly skip and repeat errors from imperfect alignment. We propose RobustSpeechFlow, a training strategy that improves alignment robustness by extending contrastive flow matching with length-preserving repeat and skip latent augmentations. Requiring no external aligners or preference data, our method directly penalizes realistic failure m

summary.core_problem: 流匹配TTS模型存在内容保真度问题，尤其是对齐不完善导致的跳字和重复错误
summary.importance: 语音生成领域方法改进，提出了基于增强的对比流匹配训练策略，无需外部对齐器或偏好数据即可减少跳字/重复错误
summary.technical_approach: 在对比流匹配基础上扩展保长的重复和跳字潜在增强（latent augmentation），直接在训练中惩罚现实的失败模式，可无缝集成到现有流程
summary.experiments: 0.06B参数量模型，在Seed-TTS-eval上将WER从1.44降至1.38；在自定义ZERO500 benchmark上，NFE=24时英文CER从0.48%降至0.35%，韩文CER从0.81%降至0.57%
summary.authors_note: Supertone Inc（韩国语音技术公司）及独立研究者，无知名作者

summary_en.core_problem: Flow-matching TTS suffers from content fidelity issues, particularly skip and repeat errors caused by imperfect alignment
summary_en.importance: Methodological improvement in speech generation: an augmentation-based contrastive flow matching training strategy that reduces skip/repeat errors without external aligners or preference data
summary_en.technical_approach: Extends contrastive flow matching with length-preserving repeat and skip latent augmentations to directly penalize realistic failure modes during training; integrates readily into existing pipelines
summary_en.experiments: 0.06B parameter model; reduces WER from 1.44 to 1.38 on Seed-TTS-eval; on ZERO500 benchmark at NFE=24, reduces English CER from 0.48% to 0.35% and Korean CER from 0.81% to 0.57%
summary_en.authors_note: Supertone Inc (South Korean speech tech company) and independent researchers, no notable authors identified

recommendation.zh: TTS方向的流匹配应用，对LLM预训练研究员无直接启发，知道即可
recommendation.en: Flow matching applied to TTS; no direct relevance to LLM pretraining researchers, awareness-only

paper.title: Latent Process Generator Matching
paper.abstract: Many recent flow-matching and diffusion-style generative models rely on auxiliary stochastic dynamics during training: a richer process is simulated to define conditional targets, but the auxiliary state is either intractable to sample at generation time or simply not part of the desired output. Existing Generator Matching theory formalises conditioning on static latent random variables, and several recent papers prove special cases of projection results for particular augmented-state constructi

summary.core_problem: 现有流匹配和扩散生成模型常借助辅助随机过程（扩展状态空间上的马尔可夫过程）来训练，但生成时仅需在观测空间上模拟，需要将扩展状态的生成器投影到观测空间。目前这类投影结果均为案例式推导，且限制辅助状态为离散型，缺乏统一理论框架。
summary.importance: 为扩散/流匹配建模范式提供了更通用的理论基础，允许设计新的训练方案——例如用连续或流形值的辅助过程而非仅离散辅助变量。这对设计更灵活的 token 级生成（如变长文本、视频帧插入）有理论指导意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出隐过程生成器匹配（Latent Process Generator Matching）框架：给定任意状态空间 𝒴 上的时齐 Feller 过程 (Yₜ)，以及可测映射 Φ: 𝒴 → 𝒳，可直接学习观测空间 𝒳 上的 Feller 过程生成器，使其单时刻边缘分布与 (Φ(Yₜ)) 的边缘分布一致。核心贡献是将 Generator Matching 理论从对静态隐变量的条件推广到对隐随机过程的条件。当 𝒴 = 𝒳 × 𝒵 且 Φ 为第一坐标投影时，该框架统一了 Edit Flows、OneFlow、Flowception、Branching Flows、Kim et al. (2025) 等多项先前工作作为特例——这些工作各自独立推导了离散隐过程的投影公式。论文给出了一般情形下损失函数的有效性充分条件，并以蛋白质结构生成为例，展示了如何设计非投影型 Φ 映射来分离链级刚体运动和残基级内部柔性。
summary.experiments: 暂无大规模实验结果。论文主要贡献为理论框架，第 4 节仅给出了蛋白质结构生成应用的概念性设计（未来工作计划实现）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 3 节 Pushforward Generator Matching 的定义和定理证明，理解如何将隐过程边际化并保持生成器的线性参数化。第 2 节对先前工作的综述可帮助定位该理论在现有扩散/流匹配谱系中的位置。阅读时间约 25 分钟，适合对生成建模理论基础感兴趣的研究者。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息未在全文中明确标注。

summary_en.core_problem: Modern flow-matching and diffusion generative models often train with auxiliary stochastic processes (Markov processes on extended state spaces), but at generation time only need to simulate on the observation space. Existing projection results are derived case-by-case and restricted to discrete auxiliary states, lacking a unifying theoretical framework.
summary_en.importance: Provides a more general theoretical foundation for diffusion/flow matching paradigms, enabling the design of novel training schemes—for instance, using continuous or manifold-valued auxiliary processes rather than only discrete ones. This has theoretical implications for designing more flexible token-level generation (e.g., variable-length text, video frame insertion).
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Latent Process Generator Matching framework: given a time-inhomogeneous Feller process (Yₜ) on an arbitrary state space 𝒴 and a measurable map Φ: 𝒴 → 𝒳, one can directly learn the generator of a Feller process on 𝒳 whose one-time marginals match those of (Φ(Yₜ)). The core contribution extends Generator Matching theory from conditioning on static latent variables to conditioning on a latent stochastic process. When 𝒴 = 𝒳 × 𝒵 and Φ projects to the first coordinate, this framework unifies multiple prior works (Edit Flows, OneFlow, Flowception, Branching Flows, Kim et al. 2025) as special cases, each of which independently derived projection formulas for discrete latent processes. The paper gives sufficient conditions for loss function validity in the general case, and uses protein structure generation as a worked example showing how to design a non-projection Φ to separate chain-level rigid-body motion from residue-level internal flexibility.
summary_en.experiments: No large-scale experimental results. The contribution is primarily theoretical. Section 4 provides only a conceptual design for protein structure generation application (planned for future implementation).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the definition and proof of Pushforward Generator Matching, understanding how latent processes are marginalized while preserving linear parameterization of the generator. Section 2's survey of prior work helps contextualize this theory within the broader diffusion/flow matching landscape. Reading time: ~25 minutes. Suitable for researchers interested in generative modeling theory foundations.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional affiliation not explicitly stated in the full text.

recommendation.zh: 可参考该框架适配离散文本扩散/流匹配建模，仅读理论推导部分即可
recommendation.en: Reference this framework for discrete text diffusion/flow matching adaptation, only read the theoretical derivation sections

paper.title: What Semantics Survive the Connector? Diagnosing VLM-to-DiT Alignment in Video Editing
paper.abstract: Flow matching based video generative models have been increasingly relying on prepended Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to handle complex, instruction-based video editing. The prevailing assumption underlying this paradigm is that a connector module can seamlessly align the VLM's rich multi-modal reasoning with the original text embedding space of DiTs. However, we hypothesize that this alignment acts as a severe semantic bottleneck, degrading fine-grained structural variables. Verifying this is c

summary.core_problem: 基于流匹配的视频生成模型普遍依赖前置VLM来处理复杂指令编辑，但连接器模块在对齐VLM与DiT文本嵌入空间时可能成为严重的语义瓶颈，导致细粒度结构信息退化。
summary.importance: 首次系统性诊断VLM-to-DiT对齐中的语义丢失问题，通过精心设计的控制数据集分离对齐失败与生成错误，属于有价值的机制分析。
summary.technical_approach: 提出TRACE-Edit诊断数据集（基于视频合成的控制数据处理流水线，聚焦关系型编辑），并设计了一套诊断协议来分析元查询（meta-query）和连接器（connector）两种设计方案。
summary.experiments: 在TRACE-Edit数据集上对现有视频编辑模型进行诊断评估，量化了VLM语义经过连接器后的丢失程度，识别出元查询和连接器设计中的具体缺陷。
summary.authors_note: 复旦大学颜伟峰团队与商汤科技，颜伟峰是多媒体领域知名学者。

summary_en.core_problem: Flow-matching video generation models rely on prepended VLMs for complex instruction editing, but the connector module aligning VLM with DiT text embeddings may act as a severe semantic bottleneck, degrading fine-grained structural information.
summary_en.importance: First systematic diagnosis of semantic loss in VLM-to-DiT alignment, disentangling alignment failures from generation errors via a controlled dataset — a valuable mechanism analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes TRACE-Edit diagnostic dataset (controlled video composition pipeline focusing on relation-based editing) and a comprehensive diagnostic protocol to analyze meta-query and connector designs.
summary_en.experiments: Diagnostic evaluation on TRACE-Edit quantifying semantic loss after the connector, identifying specific limitations in both meta-query and connector designs of existing video editing models.
summary_en.authors_note: Yanwei Fu's group at Fudan University plus SenseTime researchers; Yanwei Fu is a well-known multimedia researcher.

recommendation.zh: 多模态视频编辑领域的机制诊断，对理解VLM-DiT对齐瓶颈有一定参考价值，但与LLM预训练直接关联较弱，扫一眼摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Mechanistic diagnosis in multimodal video editing, somewhat informative for understanding VLM-DiT alignment bottlenecks but weakly connected to LLM pretraining. Glance at the abstract.

paper.title: FullFlow: Upgrading Text-to-Image Flow Matching Models for Bidirectional Vision--Language Generation
paper.abstract: Modern text-to-image diffusion models encode rich visual priors, but expose them only through one-way text-conditioned generation. Existing unified vision--language models derived from them recover bidirectional capability through large-scale joint pretraining or substantial retraining of the text pathway, discarding the strong image prior the text-to-image backbone already encodes. We introduce \emph{FullFlow}, a parameter-efficient recipe that upgrades a pretrained rectified-flow text-to-image

summary.core_problem: 预训练的文生图整流流模型仅支持单向文本到图像生成，现有统一多模态模型要么需要大规模联合预训练，要么大量重训文本通路，浪费了原有文生图backbone已编码的强图像先验，且训练成本过高。
summary.importance: 为基于流模型的统一多模态基座预训练提供了低成本的参数高效改造方案，验证了文生图模型内部已编码足够的视觉语义结构，可支撑双向图文生成任务，降低了相关研究的实验门槛。
summary.technical_approach: 提出FullFlow方案，对图像和文本做非对称兼容处理：图像保留原生连续整流流隐空间，文本采用基于Edit Flows的轻量离散插入过程；两类模态共享同一个backbone，图像和文本的时间步解耦，推理时在二维生成空间选择不同轨迹即可实现不同任务：固定一个模态实现条件生成，同时演化两个模态实现无约束图文联合采样，约束目标span实现VQA等部分文本预测任务。仅训练LoRA适配器和轻量文本头，可训练参数占比约5%。
summary.experiments: 在SD3上和同等参数量、LoRA秩的Dual Diffusion-LoRA基线相比，相同梯度步数下，文生图FID从62.7降至29.3，图像描述CIDEr从2.0升至13.4；相同运行时长下CIDEr可达99.4，训练吞吐量是基线的8倍，峰值显存不到基线的一半。方案可迁移到FLUX.1-dev，支持联合图文采样和下游VQA任务，整个改造过程在2张RTX A5000消费级GPU上24小时即可完成。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看引言部分的问题提出、双时间步联合建模设计章节、实验对比部分，泛读预计耗时20分钟，不需要深入推导流匹配的背景公式。

summary_en.core_problem: Pretrained rectified flow text-to-image models only support one-way text-to-image generation. Existing unified vision-language models either require large-scale joint pretraining or extensive retraining of the text pathway, wasting the strong image prior already encoded in the original text-to-image backbone, and incur prohibitive training costs.
summary_en.importance: Provides a parameter-efficient low-cost modification recipe for unified multimodal foundation pretraining based on flow models, verifies that text-to-image models already encode sufficient visual-semantic structure internally to support bidirectional vision-language generation tasks, and lowers the experimental barrier for related research.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes FullFlow, which treats images and text asymmetrically but compatibly: images remain in the native continuous rectified flow latent space, while text is processed via a lightweight discrete insertion process built on Edit Flows. The two modalities share a single backbone, with decoupled image and text timesteps. Different generation tasks are implemented by selecting different trajectories in the 2D generative space during inference: fixing one modality for conditional generation, evolving both modalities for unconstrained joint image-text sampling, and constraining target spans for partial text prediction tasks such as VQA. Only LoRA adapters and lightweight text heads are trained, accounting for ~5% of total parameters.
summary_en.experiments: On SD3, compared with the Dual Diffusion-LoRA baseline with the same trainable parameter count and LoRA rank, under the same gradient steps, text-to-image FID decreases from 62.7 to 29.3, and image captioning CIDEr increases from 2.0 to 13.4. Under matched wall-clock time, CIDEr reaches 99.4, with 8x training throughput and less than half the peak VRAM of the baseline. The recipe transfers to FLUX.1-dev, supports joint image-text sampling and downstream VQA tasks, and the full modification process completes in 24 hours on two consumer-grade RTX A5000 GPUs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the problem statement in the introduction, the dual timestep joint modeling design in Section 3, and the experimental comparison in Section 4. Skim reading takes approximately 20 minutes, no need to dive into the background formulas of flow matching.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是“少改 backbone，把单向 T2I 先验改造成双向生成器”这条路线；先读方法图和消融，若对照没严格控数据预算，就把结论当工程技巧而非范式信号。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the retrofit idea—turning a one-way T2I prior into a bidirectional generator with minimal backbone changes; read the method figure and ablations first, and treat it as an engineering recipe unless the compute/data controls are clean.

paper.title: FlowLong: Inference-time Long Video Generation via Manifold-constrained Tweedie Matching
paper.abstract: Extending the generation horizon of video diffusion models to long sequences remains a long-standing and important challenge. Existing training-free approaches fall into two categories: extensions of bidirectional models, which are tightly coupled to specific architectures and suffer from quality degradation over long horizons, and autoregressive models, which accumulate drift errors due to exposure bias and tend to produce repetitive motion patterns. To address these issues, we propose a novel

summary.core_problem: 现有长视频生成方法要么绑定特定架构存在质量退化，要么自回归累积漂移误差生成重复内容
summary.importance: 提出无需额外训练、架构无关的推理时长视频生成方法
summary.technical_approach: 滑动窗口生成内容，重叠区域通过Tweedie匹配保证流形约束和时序一致性，随机早期采样注入噪声同步轨迹
summary.experiments: 未公开具体量化对比结果

summary_en.core_problem: Existing long video generation methods are either tied to specific architectures with quality degradation, or accumulate drift errors to generate repetitive content in autoregressive mode
summary_en.importance: Proposes an architecture-agnostic inference-time long video generation method without extra training
summary_en.technical_approach: Generate content via sliding windows, enforce manifold constraint and temporal consistency on overlapping regions via Tweedie matching, inject noise via stochastic early-phase sampling to synchronize trajectories
summary_en.experiments: No specific quantitative comparison results are disclosed

recommendation.zh: 纯视频生成推理优化工作，做多模态生成研究时可备查，无需读正文
recommendation.en: Pure inference optimization for video generation, for reference only when doing multimodal generation research, no need to read full text

paper.title: PaintCopilot: Modeling Painting as Autonomous Artistic Continuation
paper.abstract: We present PaintCopilot, a co-creative neural painting assistant that models painting as an open-ended autoregressive artistic behavior conditioned on evolving canvas states and prior brushstroke history, without requiring a target image. Unlike existing neural painting methods that frame painting as pixel reconstruction toward a predefined reference, PaintCopilot predicts future strokes directly from learned artistic dynamics, analogous to how large language models continue text sequences from

summary.core_problem: 现有神经绘画方法依赖预定义参考图做像素重建，无法支持开放协同创作
summary.importance: 首次将绘画建模为类LLM的自回归行为续写，提出无参考图的协同绘画助手框架
summary.technical_approach: 三个互补模型：ViT意图预测器，flow matching自回归笔触预测器，VAE区域采样器，支持四种交互工作流
summary.experiments: 未公开具体量化对比结果
summary.authors_note: MIT Media Lab，Paul Pu Liang团队专注多模态建模与统一表示研究

summary_en.core_problem: Existing neural painting methods rely on predefined reference images for pixel reconstruction, cannot support open-ended co-creation
summary_en.importance: First to model painting as LLM-like autoregressive behavior continuation, proposes a reference-free co-creative painting assistant framework
summary_en.technical_approach: Three complementary models: ViT intent predictor, flow matching autoregressive stroke predictor, VAE region sampler, supports four interactive workflows
summary_en.experiments: No specific quantitative comparison results are disclosed
summary_en.authors_note: MIT Media Lab, Paul Pu Liang's team focuses on multimodal modeling and unified representation research

recommendation.zh: 将AR文本建模范式迁移到笔触生成，做多模态统一生成研究时可参考建模思路
recommendation.en: Migrates AR text modeling paradigm to stroke generation, refer to modeling ideas when studying unified multimodal generation

paper.title: Linear-DPO: Linear Direct Preference Optimization for Diffusion and Flow-Matching Generative Models
paper.abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is successful for alignment in LLMs but still faces challenges in text-to-image generation. Existing studies are confined to denoising diffusion models while overlooking flow-matching, and suffer from an objective mismatch when applying discrete NLP-based DPO to regression-based generative tasks.\ In this paper, we derive a generalized DPO objective that covers both diffusion and flow-matching via a unified reverse-time SDE framework, and point out from a gra

summary.core_problem: 解决 DPO 直接迁移到文本到图像 diffusion / flow-matching 模型时的目标错配问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是偏好优化方法改造。它把 LLM 中常用的 DPO 对齐思想重新推导到连续回归式生成模型上，尤其补上了 flow-matching 模型这一支，对多模态生成模型的偏好训练有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文在统一 reverse-time SDE 框架下推导 diffusion 与 flow-matching 的广义 DPO 目标，并从梯度角度指出标准 sigmoid 型 DPO utility 对图像生成过于激进。Linear-DPO 用线性 utility 替代 sigmoid utility，使偏好梯度更持续，同时引入 EMA 更新的 reference model 稳定训练。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 SD1.5、SDXL 等 denoising diffusion 模型，以及 SD3-Medium 这类 flow-matching 模型。论文报告定性和定量指标均优于已有 diffusion preference optimization baseline，但摘要未给出具体数据规模和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自哈尔滨工业大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the objective mismatch that appears when DPO is directly applied to text-to-image diffusion and flow-matching models.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a preference-optimization method for continuous generative models. It re-derives DPO-style alignment outside discrete autoregressive language modeling and explicitly includes flow-matching models, which makes it relevant to multimodal generation training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors derive a generalized DPO objective under a unified reverse-time SDE formulation for both diffusion and flow matching. They argue from the gradient form that the standard sigmoid-based DPO utility is too aggressive for regression-based image generation, then propose Linear-DPO with a sustained linear utility and an EMA-updated reference model.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are reported on SD1.5, SDXL, and SD3-Medium. The paper claims qualitative and quantitative gains over existing baselines, but the abstract does not provide exact dataset sizes or improvement numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Harbin Institute of Technology.

recommendation.zh: 只看目标推导和梯度分析即可；它对连续生成模型的 DPO 迁移有用，但离 LLM 预训练主线较远。
recommendation.en: Read only the objective derivation and gradient analysis; useful for DPO in continuous generators, but peripheral to LLM pretraining.

paper.title: FlowErase-RL: Rethinking Concept Erasure as Reward Optimization in Flow Matching Models
paper.abstract: Recent advances in flow matching models have significantly improved text-to-image generation quality, but also introduce growing safety risks due to the generation of harmful or undesirable content. Existing concept erasure methods are either inference-time interventions with limited effectiveness or rely on supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which requires precisely aligned data and struggles with scalability and multi-concept settings. In this paper, we propose \emph{FlowErase-RL}, the first GRPO-b

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文把 flow matching 文生图模型中的 concept erasure 从监督微调问题改写成奖励优化问题，目标是在抑制指定概念的同时尽量保留非目标概念的生成能力。
summary.importance: 它对 LLM 基座预训练的直接关系不强，但对 post-train 与生成模型安全训练有参考价值。关键启发是：当精确配对数据难以构造，或者目标概念较多时，可以把删除、保留、质量控制拆成可验证奖励，再用 GRPO 类方法优化生成轨迹。这个思路和文本模型里的 RL 后训练有相似之处：奖励设计的质量决定了模型是学到真正的约束，还是只学到绕过评测器。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 FlowErase-RL。它基于 Flow-GRPO，把 flow matching 模型的采样轨迹看作一组可优化的 sequential policy：同一个 prompt 下采样多条生成轨迹，用最终图像的 reward 做 group-normalized advantage，并把这个 advantage 分配到轨迹上的各个 velocity prediction step。奖励设计是双路径的。Concept Erasure reward 使用带目标概念和不带目标概念的 prompt pair，引导模型远离要删除的概念。Non-target Space reward 使用 retain set，约束模型在无关 prompt 上保持图像质量和语义能力。训练过程中两条 reward path 会按 epoch 动态切换，并根据观察到的 erasure 表现调整强度和权重。和 inference-time intervention 相比，它直接改变模型行为；和 SFT 类 erasure 相比，它减少了对精确对齐训练样本的依赖，更适合多概念和现代 flow transformer 架构，例如 FLUX。
summary.experiments: 论文在多个目标概念上评估 FlowErase-RL，主要场景是基于 flow matching 和 transformer 架构的 FLUX。报告结果显示，该方法在概念抑制上优于或接近现有 concept erasure 方法，同时较好保留非目标 prompt 的生成质量。论文还声称方法可迁移到其他 T2I 架构。给出的材料没有包含完整实验表格、具体 reward 形式、目标概念列表、训练步数、显存成本和指标数值，因此只能确认实验方向和结论，不能复述精确提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看方法部分的三点：Flow-GRPO 如何把 velocity prediction 变成 policy optimization，CE reward 如何从 prompt pair 构造，NS reward 如何约束 retain set。实验部分优先看 erasure 成功率与非目标质量指标是否存在 trade-off，以及动态双路径奖励相对固定权重奖励的消融。对做预训练或后训练的人，值得关注的是 reward 是否会引入分布偏移，以及 retain set 是否足以覆盖模型原有能力空间。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reframes concept erasure in flow-matching text-to-image models as a reward optimization problem, aiming to suppress target concepts while preserving generation quality on unrelated prompts.
summary_en.importance: The connection to LLM pretraining is indirect, but the work is relevant to post-training and safety optimization for generative models. The useful idea is to replace paired supervised erasure data with verifiable rewards: one reward removes the target concept, and another protects the non-target distribution. This is close in spirit to RL-based alignment for language models, where the reward design determines whether the model learns the intended constraint or only exploits the evaluator.
summary_en.technical_approach: FlowErase-RL builds on Flow-GRPO. A flow-matching sampler is treated as a sequential policy over velocity predictions. For a prompt, the model samples a group of trajectories, scores the final images, computes group-normalized advantages, and assigns the same trajectory-level advantage to the per-timestep velocity predictions. The method uses a dynamic dual-path reward. The Concept Erasure reward is built from prompt pairs with and without the target concept, pushing the model away from the concept to be erased. The Non-target Space reward uses a retain set to preserve image quality and semantic fidelity for unrelated prompts. The two reward paths are switched by epoch, with reward strength and weighting adjusted according to observed erasure behavior. Compared with inference-time interventions, this changes the model policy directly. Compared with SFT-based erasure, it reduces reliance on precisely aligned erasure data and is better matched to modern flow-transformer systems such as FLUX.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates the method on multiple target concepts, mainly using FLUX-style flow-matching models. The reported results show stronger concept suppression than prior erasure methods while maintaining non-target generation quality. The authors also report transfer to other text-to-image architectures. The supplied material does not include the full result tables, exact metrics, target concept lists, training cost, or numerical gains, so only the experimental claims and qualitative findings can be summarized reliably.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim should focus on the method. Read how Flow-GRPO is adapted to velocity prediction, how the CE reward is defined from prompt pairs, and how the NS reward is computed from the retain set. In the experiments, look for the trade-off between erasure success and non-target image quality, and for ablations comparing dynamic dual-path rewards with fixed reward weighting. For post-training researchers, the main questions are reward robustness, distribution shift induced by erasure, and whether the retain set covers enough of the original model capability.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 reward 设计；它把 GRPO 用到 flow matching，比擦除任务本身更值得看，但要警惕 reward 是否只学会分类器漏洞。
recommendation.en: Skim the reward design; applying GRPO to flow matching is more interesting than the erasure task itself, but watch for classifier-reward loopholes.

institutions: Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School, Tsinghua University

paper.title: PhyWorld: Physics-Faithful World Model for Video Generation
paper.abstract: World simulators can provide safe and scalable environments for training Physical AI systems before real-world deployment. Large video generation models are emerging as a promising basis for such simulators because they can generate diverse and realistic visual futures. However, using them as world simulators requires physically faithful video continuations, namely, generated videos that preserve the physical state implied by the conditioning input, and evolve in ways consistent with basic physi

summary.core_problem: 现有视频生成模型作为物理AI训练的世界模拟器时，生成内容物理保真度低，无法保留输入隐含的物理状态，不符合基础物理规则
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将DPO偏好对齐用于视频生成的物理约束优化，提升生成视频的物理一致性
summary.technical_approach: 采用两阶段后训练：第一阶段用流匹配微调提升视频帧间视觉属性稳定性和运动连贯性，第二阶段基于物理偏好数据做DPO对齐生成动态与物理规则
summary.experiments: 在物理保真视频续写任务上测试，生成内容的物理一致性优于基线视频生成模型
summary.authors_note: 东北大学、佐治亚大学等机构研究团队，无公开知名相关领域作者

summary_en.core_problem: When existing video generation models act as world simulators for physical AI training, generated content has low physical fidelity, cannot preserve physical states implied by inputs, and violates basic physical principles
summary_en.importance: Method innovation, first apply DPO preference alignment to physical constraint optimization for video generation, improving physical consistency of generated videos
summary_en.technical_approach: Adopt two-stage post-training: first stage uses flow matching fine-tuning to improve inter-frame visual attribute stability and motion coherence, second stage aligns generated dynamics with physical principles via DPO on physics preference data
summary_en.experiments: Tested on physically faithful video continuation tasks, generated content outperforms baseline video generation models in physical consistency
summary_en.authors_note: Research team from Northeastern University, University of Georgia, etc., no well-known authors in related fields publicly identified

recommendation.zh: 物理对齐视频生成的增量工作，做视频世界模型研究可参考其DPO对齐思路，无需精读
recommendation.en: Incremental work on physically aligned video generation, DPO alignment idea is referable for video world model research, no need for intensive reading
