paper.title: Flow Sampling: Learning to Sample from Unnormalized Densities via Denoising Conditional Processes
paper.abstract: Sampling from unnormalized densities is analogous to the generative modeling problem, but the target distribution is defined by a known energy function instead of data samples. Because evaluating the energy function is often costly, a primary challenge is to learn an efficient sampler. We introduce Flow Sampling, a framework built on diffusion models and flow matching for the data-free setting. Our training objective is conditioned on a noise sample and regresses onto a denoising diffusion drift

summary.core_problem: 在只有未归一化能量函数、没有数据样本的设定下，如何高效学习一个采样器，从复杂分布中生成样本。
summary.importance: 这是生成建模与能量模型交叉处的方法论文。它不直接做语言建模，但对 energy-based LM、diffusion/flow 统一视角、以及“从目标密度而非数据分布学习生成器”的思路有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Flow Sampling：把扩散模型/flow matching 的训练对象从“基于数据样本回归 noising drift”改成“基于噪声样本回归由能量函数构造的 denoising drift”。作者利用 interpolant process 降低训练时对能量函数的调用次数，并把方法扩展到 Riemannian manifold。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调方法在 data-free setting 下更高效、可扩展，并支持非欧几里得几何；但没有给出与 LLM 相关的模型规模、训练 token 或语言任务结果。对预训练研究员而言，价值主要在方法视角而非可直接复现的语言实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to efficiently learn a sampler from a complex unnormalized density when only the energy function is available and no data samples are given.
summary_en.importance: This is a methods paper at the intersection of generative modeling and energy-based modeling. It is not directly about language modeling, but it is relevant to energy-based LM, diffusion/flow unification, and the broader idea of learning generators from target densities rather than empirical data.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Flow Sampling: instead of regressing a noising drift conditioned on data samples as in diffusion training, it regresses a denoising diffusion drift constructed from the energy function and conditioned on noise samples. An interpolant process is used to reduce energy-function evaluations during training, and the framework extends naturally to Riemannian manifolds.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes efficiency and scalability in the data-free setting, plus support for non-Euclidean geometry, but gives no LLM-relevant scale, token count, or language-task results. For pretraining researchers, the value is mainly conceptual rather than directly actionable.

recommendation.zh: 和 LLM 不直接相连，但做 energy-based LM 的人可以看目标构造；先看训练目标那几式，没语言实验就别投入太多时间。
recommendation.en: Not directly tied to LLMs, but worth a look if you care about energy-based LM; read the objective derivation, then stop unless you need the density-sampling angle.

paper.title: StyleShield: Exposing the Fragility of AIGC Detectors through Continuous Controllable Style Transfer
paper.abstract: AI-generated content (AIGC) detectors are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings such as academic integrity screening, yet their reliability rests on a fundamental paradox: as language models are trained on human-written corpora, the statistical boundary between AI and human writing will inevitably dissolve as models improve. Commercial incentives have further distorted this landscape -- detection services and "de-AIification" tools often operate within the same supply chain, replacing ev

summary.core_problem: AIGC 检测器通常依赖于 AI 和人类文本之间的统计差异，但随着 LLM 的进步和人类写作习惯的改变，这种差异正在消失。现有的对抗性探测方法（如重写、回译、同义词替换）要么无法有效规避检测，要么会严重破坏文本的语义和流畅度，且缺乏对转换强度的连续控制。
summary.importance: 本文提出了 StyleShield，这是首个基于流匹配（Flow Matching）的连续可控文本风格迁移框架。它不仅揭示了当前 AIGC 检测器的脆弱性，还为研究文本生成的连续控制和对抗性评估提供了一种新的范式，对理解和改进 LLM 的生成机制具有启发意义。
summary.technical_approach: StyleShield 在连续的 Token 嵌入空间中运行，将 AI 到人类的风格迁移建模为一个连续的去噪过程。核心创新包括：1) 使用预训练的 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 作为骨干网络；2) 引入零初始化的交叉注意力适配器（Cross-Attention Adapters），并以冻结的 Qwen-7B 表示为条件，以在去噪过程中保留源文本的语义；3) 引入检测器在环（Detector-in-the-loop）的奖励机制，增强对抗性反馈；4) 通过单一推理参数 $\gamma$ 实现对转换强度的连续控制。此外，还提出了 RateAudit 算法，用于在文档级别分配转换预算，以精确达到任意目标检测率。
summary.experiments: 在一个包含 43.5 万对多领域中文语料库上训练后，StyleShield 在保留 1000 个样本的测试集上，对训练检测器的规避率 $\geq$ 94.6%，对三个未见过的检测器的规避率 $\geq$ 99%，同时保持了 0.928 的语义相似度。消融实验验证了交叉注意力适配器在保留语义方面的关键作用。RateAudit 算法的成功应用进一步证明了检测率的任意可调性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注 Section 3 中的方法论部分，特别是如何在连续嵌入空间中应用流匹配（3.1）以及交叉注意力适配器的设计（3.2）。Section 3.4 关于推理参数 $\gamma$ 的讨论对于理解连续控制机制至关重要。预计阅读时间 20-30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: AIGC detectors rely on statistical differences between AI and human text, which are dissolving as LLMs improve. Existing adversarial probes (e.g., rewriting, backtranslation) either fail to evade detection or severely degrade semantic integrity, lacking continuous control over transformation intensity.
summary_en.importance: This paper introduces StyleShield, the first flow-matching framework for continuous, controllable text style transfer. It exposes the fragility of current AIGC detectors and offers a novel paradigm for studying continuous control in text generation and adversarial evaluation, providing insights for understanding and improving LLM generation mechanisms.
summary_en.technical_approach: StyleShield operates in continuous token-embedding space, modeling AI-to-human style transfer as a continuous denoising process. Key innovations include: 1) using a pretrained Diffusion Transformer (DiT) backbone; 2) introducing zero-initialized cross-attention adapters conditioned on frozen Qwen-7B representations to preserve source semantics during denoising; 3) employing a detector-in-the-loop reward for sharpened adversarial feedback; 4) enabling continuous control over transformation intensity via a single inference parameter $\gamma$. Additionally, it proposes RateAudit, a document-level scheduling algorithm to allocate transformation budgets and hit arbitrary target detection rates.
summary_en.experiments: Trained on a 435K-pair multi-domain Chinese corpus, StyleShield achieves $\geq$ 94.6% evasion against the training detector and $\geq$ 99% against three unseen detectors on a 1,000-sample held-out benchmark, while maintaining a semantic similarity of 0.928. Ablation studies validate the crucial role of cross-attention adapters in semantic preservation. The success of RateAudit further demonstrates the arbitrariness of detection rates.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (Methodology), particularly the application of flow matching in continuous embedding space (3.1) and the design of cross-attention adapters (3.2). The discussion on the inference parameter $\gamma$ in Section 3.4 is key to understanding the continuous control mechanism. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法部分；检测器攻击是外壳，连续 embedding flow matching 和 SDEdit 式文本编辑更值得看。
recommendation.en: Skim the method section; the detector attack is the wrapper, while embedding-space flow matching and SDEdit-style text editing are the useful pieces.

paper.title: Divergence is Uncertainty: A Closed-Form Posterior Covariance for Flow Matching
paper.abstract: Flow matching has become a leading framework for generative modeling, but quantifying the uncertainty of its samples remains an open problem. Existing approaches retrain the model with auxiliary variance heads, maintain costly ensembles, or propagate approximate covariance through many integration steps, trading off training cost, inference cost, or accuracy. We show that none of these trade-offs is necessary. We prove that, for any pre-trained flow matching velocity field, the trace of the post

summary.core_problem: 解决流匹配生成模型样本不确定性估计成本高、需重训或集成、精度不足的问题。
summary.importance: 理论创新，首次提出流匹配的散度-不确定性恒等式，无需重训即可在任意预训练流匹配模型上计算不确定性。
summary.technical_approach: 通过数学证明得出预训练流匹配速度场的后验协方差迹等于速度场的散度，仅需已知时间相关 prefactor 和加性常数即可得到闭式解。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体实验数据，仅说明该恒等式精确、可事后计算，无需重训或额外架构修改。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自耶鲁大学医学院、中佛罗里达大学、哈佛医学院波士顿儿童医院，研究面向医疗图像生成场景。

summary_en.core_problem: Solves the problem of high cost, retraining/ensemble requirement and insufficient accuracy for sample uncertainty estimation in flow matching generative models.
summary_en.importance: Theoretical innovation, first proposes the divergence-uncertainty identity for flow matching, enabling uncertainty calculation on any pretrained flow matching model without retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proves via mathematical derivation that the trace of posterior covariance of pretrained flow matching velocity field equals the divergence of the velocity field, forming a closed-form solution with only known time-dependent prefactor and additive constant.
summary_en.experiments: No specific experimental data is disclosed in abstract, only states the identity is exact, post-hoc computable, and requires no retraining or extra architecture modification.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Yale School of Medicine, University of Central Florida, Boston Children's Hospital Harvard Medical School, targeting medical image generation scenarios.

recommendation.zh: 仅做Flow Matching LM理论储备时可参考，无语言相关实验，实用价值有限。
recommendation.en: Can be referenced as theoretical reserve for Flow Matching LM, no language-related experiments, limited practical value.

paper.title: Binomial flows: Denoising and flow matching for discrete ordinal data
paper.abstract: Flow-based generative modeling in continuous spaces exploit Tweedie's formula to express the denoiser (learned in training) as a score function (used in sampling). In contrast, this relation has been largely missing in the discrete setting where common approaches focus on learning discrete scores and rates. In this work we close this gap for discrete non-negative ordinal data by introducing Binomial flows. Our framework provides a simple recipe for training a discrete diffusion model which simul

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是离散有序数据上的一个基础缺口：连续扩散/flow matching 里，denoiser、score、sampling、likelihood 之间有一套很完整的关系，核心工具是 Tweedie 公式；但在离散空间，尤其是非负有序离散数据上，这套关系并不完整，很多方法只能直接学离散 score 或反向转移率，训练和采样都更绕。作者想做的是给离散 ordinal 数据找一个与高斯噪声相对应的 noising family，使得“学 denoiser”这条路线在离散情形下也成立，并且能导出可用的采样和似然计算公式。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 预训练的直接相关性有限，因为论文面向的是一般离散有序数据生成，不是文本语言建模，也没有讨论 tokenizer、离散序列建模或大规模预训练实践。但从新型语言建模范式的角度，它有方法论价值：一是说明离散 diffusion/flow 不一定非要围绕 score 或 rate parameterization 设计，denoiser 也可以成为一等公民；二是给“离散 Tweedie 公式”提供了一个具体可行的构造，这对未来做离散 token 生成、图像 token、音频 codec token、甚至某些 ordinal tokenizer 的统一建模有启发。贡献更偏理论与生成建模基础，不是当前 LLM pretrain pipeline 可直接落地的方案。
summary.technical_approach:
核心做法是引入 Binomial flows。作者的出发点很明确：在连续空间里，高斯噪声之所以特殊，不只是因为它好加噪，而是因为它让 denoiser 与 score 之间存在 Tweedie 关系，从而把训练目标和采样过程接起来。离散空间缺的正是这个桥。对于定义在非负有序空间上的数据，作者提出用 Binomial noising 作为高斯噪声的离散对应物。

具体上，论文先定义一族从干净样本 X_T 到中间时刻 X_t 的条件分布 p_{t|T}，要求满足三个标准性质：容易采样；t=T 时退化为原样本；t=0 时完全忘掉原样本。然后在这个 flow 上训练 denoiser m(t,x)=E[X_T|X_t=x]，训练目标是带时间权重的 Bregman divergence。这个部分和连续 diffusion 中“直接回归 clean target 的条件期望”是平行的。

关键创新在后面三步：
1. 证明在 Binomial noising 下，denoiser 满足离散版 Tweedie 公式，可以从 denoiser 恢复与当前扰动分布相关的 score-like quantity；
2. 利用这个关系，把采样过程写成 Poisson-Föllmer process，从纯噪声在有限时间内精确到达目标分布，而不是只给一个启发式反向链；
3. 推导出一个涉及 denoiser 的似然恒等式，因此模型不仅能生成，还能做 exact likelihood estimation 和相应训练。

这和常见离散 diffusion 的区别很明显。很多离散方法直接学习 p(x_0|x_t)、离散 score、或跳转 rate matrix，采样时依赖近似反向过程。这里作者强调的是：选对 noising family 后，denoiser 本身就足够支撑训练、采样和似然三件事，结构上更接近连续 diffusion 的统一配方。

需要注意的是，这个框架依赖“非负、有序、ordinal”结构。它不直接覆盖无序类别空间，因此离文本 token 这种 nominal discrete space 还有距离。若想迁移到 LM，需要额外的 token ordering 或分解结构，这不是论文当前解决的问题。
summary.experiments:
实验部分验证了三件事：
1. 在合成数据上，Binomial flow 的理论关系可以被数值验证，说明 denoiser→sampling→likelihood 这条链条是闭合的；
2. 在真实数据上，方法能得到有竞争力的生成质量，摘要里明确提到 imaging datasets 上取得了 competitive FID；
3. 论文不仅展示采样，还展示 exact likelihood estimation，这一点和很多只报生成质量的离散 diffusion 工作不同。

从当前提供的正文片段看，实验章节的具体数据表没有展开，因此无法准确给出数据集名称、模型规模、FID 数值、训练步数或与哪些 baseline 的具体差距。能确认的是，作者同时做了 synthetic 和 real-world datasets，两类实验分别对应理论正确性与实际生成性能。阅读时应特别看：不同 Bregman divergence 的影响、Binomial noising 参数化是否敏感、Poisson-Föllmer 采样在有限步数下的稳定性，以及 likelihood 估计是否真的可计算而不是高方差近似。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“定义—定理—实验”三步读。
1. 先看 Introduction 和 Section 2 开头，弄清作者为什么认为 Binomial 是离散 ordinal 空间里更自然的 Gaussian analogue。这里如果没看懂，后面的 Tweedie 公式就会显得像技巧堆砌。
2. 再看离散 Tweedie 公式和 Poisson-Föllmer process 的主定理。这是全文核心。重点不是逐行验算，而是理解：denoiser 如何转成可采样的对象，为什么能在有限时间精确采样，以及这个“精确”依赖哪些假设。
3. 最后看 likelihood identity 和实验。若只想判断方法是否值得继续跟，实验部分看 synthetic 验证图和真实数据主表即可。

预计阅读时间 35–50 分钟。对做离散 diffusion、图像/音频 token 生成、或非 AR 语言建模的人有方法启发；若只做标准文本 AR 预训练，可以只读引言、主定理和实验结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a structural gap in discrete generative modeling for ordinal data. In continuous diffusion and flow matching, denoising, score estimation, sampling, and likelihood are tied together by a clean mathematical relation centered on Tweedie’s formula. In discrete spaces, especially for non-negative ordered data, that bridge is largely missing, so many methods learn discrete scores or jump rates directly and rely on less unified sampling procedures. The goal here is to identify a noising family for discrete ordinal data that plays the role Gaussian noise plays in the continuous case, so that denoiser-based training can again support sampling and likelihood evaluation in a principled way.
summary_en.importance: The paper is only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining. It is not about text language modeling, tokenizers, or large-scale pretraining practice. Its value is methodological. First, it shows that discrete diffusion and flow models do not have to be built only around score or rate parameterizations; denoisers can be the central object if the noise model is chosen correctly. Second, it provides a concrete construction of a discrete Tweedie-type relation, which could matter for future work on discrete token generation, image tokens, audio codec tokens, or other ordinal latent spaces. The contribution is more foundational for discrete generative modeling than immediately actionable for current LLM pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main idea is to introduce Binomial flows. The motivation is precise: Gaussian noise is special in continuous diffusion not merely because it is easy to sample, but because it yields Tweedie’s formula, which connects the denoiser to the score and thereby links training to sampling. The discrete setting lacks this bridge. For data living on a non-negative ordered space, the authors propose Binomial noising as the discrete analogue of Gaussian perturbation.

They first define a family of conditional distributions p_{t|T} that maps a clean sample X_T to an intermediate noisy sample X_t, with the usual three properties: easy perturbation, identity at t=T, and complete forgetting at t=0. On top of this flow they train a denoiser m(t,x)=E[X_T|X_t=x] using a time-weighted Bregman-divergence objective. This mirrors the standard denoiser-training view in continuous diffusion.

The technical contribution then comes in three linked steps:
1. under Binomial noising, the denoiser satisfies a discrete Tweedie formula, allowing recovery of a score-like object from the denoiser;
2. this relation leads to a sampling procedure via the Poisson-Föllmer process, which reaches the target distribution exactly in finite time rather than through a purely heuristic reverse chain;
3. the authors derive a likelihood identity involving the Binomial-flow denoiser, enabling exact likelihood estimation and corresponding training.

This differs from many discrete diffusion models that directly learn p(x_0|x_t), a discrete score, or a jump-rate matrix and then sample using approximate reverse dynamics. Here the claim is stronger: with the right noising family, the denoiser alone can support training, sampling, and likelihood in a unified recipe, much closer in spirit to continuous diffusion.

An important limitation is that the framework relies on non-negative ordinal structure. It does not directly apply to unordered categorical spaces, so there is still a gap to standard text tokens, which are nominal rather than ordinal. Extending the idea to language would require additional structure that this paper does not provide.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments appear to validate three points.
1. On synthetic data, the theoretical chain from denoiser to sampling and likelihood is numerically verified, showing that the proposed construction is internally consistent.
2. On real datasets, the method achieves competitive generative performance; the abstract explicitly mentions competitive FID on imaging datasets.
3. Unlike many discrete diffusion papers that only report sample quality, this one also demonstrates exact likelihood estimation.

The provided excerpt does not include the full experimental tables, dataset names, model sizes, FID values, training budgets, or exact margins over baselines, so precise numbers should not be fabricated. What can be stated safely is that the evaluation spans both synthetic and real-world datasets, with the former supporting the theory and the latter testing practical generation quality. When reading the experiments, the most useful checks are the effect of different Bregman divergences, sensitivity to the Binomial noising parameterization, stability of Poisson-Föllmer sampling in finite time, and whether the likelihood computation is truly exact rather than a noisy approximation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the order definition, theorem, experiment.
1. Start with the introduction and the opening of Section 2 to understand why the authors regard Binomial noise as the natural Gaussian analogue for discrete ordinal spaces. Without that intuition, the later Tweedie result can look arbitrary.
2. Then read the main theorem on the discrete Tweedie formula and the Poisson-Föllmer process. This is the core of the paper. The key question is not line-by-line proof checking, but understanding how the denoiser becomes a sampling object, why finite-time exact sampling is possible, and which assumptions that exactness depends on.
3. Finish with the likelihood identity and the experiments. If the goal is only to assess whether the method is worth following, the synthetic validation figures and the main real-data table are enough.

Estimated reading time is 35–50 minutes. It is more useful for readers working on discrete diffusion, image/audio token generation, or non-AR generative modeling than for readers focused on standard autoregressive text pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 离散扩散语言模型（Diffusion LM）的底层理论补丁，用二项分布推导了离散 Tweedie 公式，做 SEDD/MDLM 方向的必看理论推导。
recommendation.en: A fundamental theoretical patch for discrete diffusion LMs, deriving a discrete Tweedie's formula via binomial distributions; a must-read for theoretical foundations in the SEDD/MDLM direction.

institutions: Division of Applied Mathematics, Brown University, Providence, RI

paper.title: Frequency-Forcing: From Scaling-as-Time to Soft Frequency Guidance
paper.abstract: While standard flow-matching models transport noise to data uniformly, incorporating an explicit generation order - specifically, establishing coarse, low-frequency structure before fine detail - has proven highly effective for synthesizing natural images. Two recent works offer distinct paradigms for this. K-Flow imposes a hard frequency constraint by reinterpreting a frequency scaling variable as flow time, running the trajectory inside a transformed amplitude space. Latent Forcing provides a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体但很关键的问题：在 flow matching 图像生成里，如何把“先生成低频结构，再补高频细节”这件事从网络的隐式学习动态，变成一个可控、可组合、且不破坏原始像素流路径的显式训练机制。作者认为，标准 flow matching 虽然会因为谱偏置和噪声日程自然学到一些 coarse-to-fine 顺序，但这种顺序是弱的、混杂的，频段之间存在梯度竞争，也没有明确的时间控制。已有两条路线各有代价：K-Flow 通过把频率尺度直接改写成 flow 时间来做硬约束，但会改变状态空间和轨迹定义；Latent Forcing 保留像素路径，只在辅助语义流上做异步成熟，但依赖外部预训练语义编码器，且没有直接利用图像自身的频率结构。作者要解决的，就是能否把“频率先行”作为一种 soft guidance 注入标准 flow matching，而不是重写整个生成坐标系。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要不在“图像生成指标又涨了多少”，而在建模接口设计。它把“生成顺序”拆成两个正交维度：一是按什么表示来排序，二是通过什么机制把排序注入主干生成过程。K-Flow 选的是频率轴，但机制是 hard constraint；Latent Forcing 选的是 forcing 机制，但表示是外部语义 latent。Frequency-Forcing 的价值在于把这两者重新组合：保留标准像素空间 flow matching 的路径与兼容性，用一个来自数据自身的低频 scratchpad 做异步引导。这种思路对更广义的预训练也有参考意义：很多“先学结构、后学细节”的 inductive bias，不一定要写进主目标或主状态空间，也可以通过附加流、异步时间、辅助表示来软注入。对于统一建模、多流预训练、甚至 AR/diffusion 混合范式，这是一种值得注意的接口设计。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者基本沿用了 Latent Forcing 的多时间 forcing 框架，但把辅助流从“外部语义 latent”换成“数据自带的低频表示”。主干像素分支仍然是标准线性 flow-matching 插值，不改 endpoint，不改 trajectory，因此训练和采样流程与 vanilla flow matching 保持结构一致。辅助分支则接收从图像中提取的低频 scratchpad，并通过异步时间调度让它比像素分支更早成熟，从而在去噪早期提供稳定的结构信号。这里的关键不是把低频信息直接拼接进去，而是让它作为一个先成熟的条件流，形成 soft frequency guidance。

作者强调了两个设计点。第一，scratchpad 不是固定 Haar 或 Laplacian 之类的手工频率基，而是通过可学习 wavelet packet analysis filter 从数据中学出来。训练时加入 sparsity regularization 和 quadrature-mirror-filter 约束，使得到的基既稀疏又近似正交。这样做的动机很明确：固定基的低频定义更多来自设计者选择，不一定贴合数据统计；可学习基则让“什么算结构、什么算细节”由数据决定。第二，方法是 path-preserving 的。与 K-Flow 不同，它没有把 flow 时间改写成频率尺度，也没有把状态空间搬到变换域，因此可以直接兼容 vanilla flow matching pipeline，也更容易叠加别的先验。文中还专门展示了 frequency stream 和 DINO semantic stream 可以同时挂接，说明 forcing 机制在表示层面是可组合的，而不是一次只能押注一种先验。

从方法论上看，这篇工作的核心创新不是提出一个全新的生成目标，而是把“频率顺序”从 transformed-space hard constraint 改成 auxiliary-stream soft guidance，并进一步把辅助表示从外部蒸馏语义改成 self-forcing 的数据内生频率表示。这种改法保住了兼容性，也降低了对大外部编码器的依赖。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文内容看，实验重点有三类。第一类是主结果：显式频率引导优于 plain pixel-space flow matching，说明标准 flow matching 虽然隐式存在 coarse-to-fine 动态，但强度不够；给生成路径注入低频信号后，质量有稳定增益。第二类是方法对比：作者把自己的方法放在 K-Flow 与 Latent Forcing 之间来定位。相对 K-Flow，它不追求 transformed-space 的频率编辑或 restoration 能力，而是强调在 generative quality 上用更低结构代价获得收益；相对 Latent Forcing，它不依赖 DINO 这类重型外部语义编码器，而是用轻量 wavelet packet 低频表示完成自监督式引导。第三类是消融：文中明确提到 learnable wavelet basis 优于固定 Haar 或 Laplacian basis；同时，frequency stream 之上再叠加 DINO stream 还能继续提升，说明频率先验和语义先验不是互斥关系，而是互补关系。

不过，当前提供的全文片段没有包含完整实验表格、具体数据集、参数规模、FID 或其他指标的精确数字，也没有看到训练算力与采样开销的完整统计。因此能确认的实验结论是方向性的：1）soft frequency guidance 在 vanilla flow matching 之上有净增益；2）learnable basis 比固定 basis 更好；3）frequency forcing 与 semantic forcing 可叠加。若要做严格复现或判断量级，仍需查看结果章节中的主表、消融表和附录实现细节。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议先抓三处。第一，看 Introduction 里对 K-Flow 和 Latent Forcing 的拆解，重点不是背景综述，而是作者如何把“排序轴”和“注入机制”分开，这决定了整篇工作的设计空间。第二，看方法部分关于 self-forcing signal、异步时间调度、以及 learnable wavelet basis 的定义，尤其是 analysis filter 如何训练、用了哪些正则、低频 scratchpad 如何接入主干网络。第三，看实验中的三组消融：plain FM vs frequency-forcing、fixed basis vs learnable basis、frequency stream vs frequency+DINO。读这三组基本就能判断这篇工作的真实贡献在哪里。

如果时间有限，预计 20 到 30 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。优先看 Table 1 的方法定位、方法图、basis 学习公式、以及主结果与消融表。需要注意的一点是，不要把它误读成“频域 flow matching”的又一个变体；它更接近“在不改主路径的前提下，用辅助流显式安排生成顺序”。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific modeling question in flow-matching image generation: how to make coarse-to-fine generation explicit without rewriting the main flow trajectory. Standard flow matching already exhibits some low-to-high frequency ordering because low-frequency modes are easier to fit under high noise, but that ordering is weak, entangled, and not directly controllable. Existing solutions split into two camps. K-Flow enforces frequency order by redefining flow time along a frequency scale, which gives a hard constraint but changes the state space and interpolation path. Latent Forcing keeps the pixel path intact and introduces asynchronous maturation through an auxiliary semantic stream, but it relies on a heavy pretrained encoder and does not directly exploit image-native frequency structure. The paper asks whether frequency ordering can be injected as a soft guidance signal while preserving vanilla pixel-space flow matching.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is architectural rather than benchmark-driven. The paper cleanly separates two design dimensions that are often conflated: what representation should mature earlier, and by what mechanism that ordering should influence generation. K-Flow chooses frequency as the ordering axis but uses a hard transformed-space constraint. Latent Forcing chooses a flexible forcing mechanism but uses external semantic latents. Frequency-Forcing recombines these choices: it keeps the standard pixel-space flow path and uses a self-derived low-frequency scratchpad as an auxiliary stream. That is a useful pattern for pretraining research more broadly. If one wants structure-before-detail behavior, the bias does not necessarily need to be baked into the main objective or state space; it can be injected through auxiliary representations and asynchronous training dynamics. That idea is relevant beyond image generation, including multi-stream pretraining and hybrid generative paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method inherits the multi-time forcing formulation from Latent Forcing, but replaces the semantic auxiliary stream with a frequency-based one derived directly from the data. The main pixel branch remains standard linear flow-matching interpolation, so endpoints, trajectory, and compatibility with vanilla flow-matching pipelines are preserved. A separate auxiliary branch receives a low-frequency scratchpad extracted from the image, and its time schedule is advanced relative to the pixel branch so that it matures earlier and provides structural guidance during denoising. The key point is that frequency information is not imposed by redefining the flow coordinate; it is introduced as an earlier-maturing conditioning stream.

Two design choices matter. First, the frequency basis is learnable. Instead of fixing Haar, Laplacian, or another hand-designed basis, the paper learns a wavelet-packet analysis filter from data, regularized by sparsity and quadrature-mirror-filter constraints to obtain a sparse and approximately orthogonal basis. This addresses a real limitation of fixed bases: what counts as “low frequency” is otherwise determined by the designer rather than the data distribution. Second, the architecture is path-preserving. Unlike K-Flow, it does not move the process into a transformed amplitude space or reinterpret flow time as frequency scale. That preserves compatibility with standard flow matching and makes composition easier. The paper explicitly shows that a frequency stream can be combined with a DINO semantic stream, which highlights that forcing is modular at the representation level.

Methodologically, the contribution is not a new generative objective. It is a new interface for injecting generation order: soft frequency guidance through an auxiliary self-forcing stream, instead of a hard transformed-space constraint or an externally distilled semantic scratchpad.
summary_en.experiments:
From the available full-text content, the experiments support three main claims. First, explicit frequency guidance improves over plain pixel-space flow matching, which confirms the paper’s premise that implicit coarse-to-fine behavior in standard flow matching is real but insufficient. Second, the method is positioned against both K-Flow and Latent Forcing. Relative to K-Flow, it gives up transformed-space capabilities such as frequency editing and restoration, but aims for generative gains with lower structural cost. Relative to Latent Forcing, it avoids dependence on a large pretrained semantic encoder by using a lightweight wavelet-packet-derived self-forcing signal. Third, the ablations matter: a learnable wavelet basis outperforms fixed Haar or Laplacian bases, and adding a DINO stream on top of the frequency stream yields further gains, suggesting that frequency and semantic priors are complementary rather than redundant.

That said, the provided text does not include the full result tables, exact datasets, model sizes, or precise metric values such as FID. It also does not expose the full compute and sampling overhead. So the experimentally supported conclusions are directional rather than fully quantified here: explicit soft frequency guidance helps, learnable bases beat fixed ones, and the auxiliary-stream design composes with semantic forcing. For exact effect sizes, the main results and appendix need to be checked directly.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, focus on three places. First, read the introduction carefully where the paper disentangles the ordering axis from the injection mechanism. That framing is the real conceptual contribution. Second, inspect the method section for the definition of the self-forcing signal, the asynchronous time schedules, and the learnable wavelet basis, especially how the analysis filter is trained and regularized. Third, look at the core ablations: plain flow matching vs frequency-forcing, fixed basis vs learnable basis, and frequency-only vs frequency-plus-DINO.

A useful skim should take about 20–30 minutes. Prioritize the method-positioning table, the architecture figure, the equations for basis learning, and the main ablation tables. One reading trap is to treat this as just another frequency-domain flow model. It is better understood as a path-preserving way to impose generation order through auxiliary streams.

recommendation.zh: 探讨 Flow Matching 中的频率引导机制，虽然是图像生成，但其对生成顺序（coarse-to-fine）的软性控制思路对连续/离散 Diffusion LM 的轨迹设计有一定启发，可扫读方法部分。
recommendation.en: Explores frequency guidance in Flow Matching. Although focused on image generation, its soft control of generation order (coarse-to-fine) offers insights for trajectory design in continuous/discrete Diffusion LMs. Skim the method section.

paper.title: Tokenised Flow Matching for Hierarchical Simulation Based Inference
paper.abstract: The cost of simulator evaluations is a key practical bottleneck for Simulation Based Inference (SBI). In hierarchical settings with shared global parameters and exchangeable site-level parameters and observations, this structure can be exploited to improve simulation efficiency. Existing hierarchical SBI approaches factorise the posterior yet still simulate across multiple sites per training sample; We instead explore likelihood factorisation (LF) to train from single-site simulations. In LF sam

summary.core_problem: 在分层基于模拟的推理（SBI）中，如何降低模拟器评估的成本并支持函数值观测。
summary.importance: 提出了一种结合似然分解和 Tokenized Flow Matching 的新方法，用于加速分层贝叶斯推理，对将生成模型应用于科学计算有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 利用似然分解（LF）从单站点模拟中训练，学习每个站点的神经代理，然后组装合成的多站点观测。在此基础上，提出 Tokenised Flow Matching for Posterior Estimation (TFMPE)，支持函数值观测。
summary.experiments: 引入了一个分层 SBI 的 benchmark，并在其上验证了 TFMPE 的有效性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自帝国理工学院。

summary_en.core_problem: How to reduce the cost of simulator evaluations and support function-valued observations in hierarchical Simulation Based Inference (SBI).
summary_en.importance: Proposes a novel approach combining likelihood factorisation and Tokenized Flow Matching to accelerate hierarchical Bayesian inference, offering reference value for applying generative models to scientific computing.
summary_en.technical_approach: Utilizes Likelihood Factorisation (LF) to train from single-site simulations, learning a per-site neural surrogate, and then assembling synthetic multi-site observations. Builds on this to propose Tokenised Flow Matching for Posterior Estimation (TFMPE), supporting function-valued observations.
summary_en.experiments: Introduced a benchmark for hierarchical SBI and validated TFMPE on it.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Imperial College London.

recommendation.zh: 将 Flow Matching 引入分层贝叶斯推理，属于生成模型在科学计算的特定应用，对通用 LLM 预训练启发有限，作为 literature 备查。
recommendation.en: Introduces Flow Matching to hierarchical Bayesian inference; a specific application of generative models in scientific computing with limited inspiration for general LLM pretraining. Keep as literature reference.

paper.title: The Amazing Stability of Flow Matching
paper.abstract: The success of deep generative models in generating high-quality and diverse samples is often attributed to particular architectures and large training datasets. In this paper, we investigate the impact of these factors on the quality and diversity of samples generated by \emph{flow-matching} models. Surprisingly, in our experiments on CelebA-HQ dataset, flow matching remains stable even when pruning 50\% of the dataset. That is, the quality and diversity of generated samples are preserved. More

summary.core_problem: 研究 flow matching 生成模型对数据删减、架构变化和训练配置变化为何表现出异常稳定性，以及这种稳定性是否会保留潜在表示与样本质量。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型训练动力学与表征稳定性的分析。虽然对象是图像 flow matching，不是语言模型，但对新型生成范式的鲁棒性、数据效率和表示不变性有方法论参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者系统比较在 CelebA-HQ 上训练的 flow-matching 模型，在删去 50% 数据、改变架构或训练配置后，观察生成质量、多样性以及相同 seed 对应输出的潜在表示一致性，重点不是提出新模型，而是做稳定性测量。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的核心结果是：即使剪掉 50% 训练数据，样本质量和多样性仍基本保持；不同架构和训练配置下，给定 seed 的输出在视觉上仍相似，说明 latent representation 具有较强保持性。实验规模不大，主要在 CelebA-HQ 上，外推到大规模语言建模需要谨慎。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Lamarr Institute、University of Cologne、Reichman University 等机构；这更像一篇训练动力学分析工作，而非大规模工业实验室的范式报告。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why flow-matching generative models appear unusually stable under data pruning, architecture changes, and training-configuration changes, and whether this stability preserves latent representations and sample quality.
summary_en.importance: This is an analysis paper on training dynamics and representation stability in generative modeling. It is not about language models, but it may still inform thinking about robustness, data efficiency, and invariances in alternative generative paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Rather than proposing a new model, the authors systematically train flow-matching models on CelebA-HQ under 50% data pruning, architecture changes, and configuration changes, then measure sample quality, diversity, and seed-level output consistency to probe latent stability.
summary_en.experiments: The headline result is that pruning 50% of the dataset barely hurts sample quality or diversity, and that changing architecture or training configuration still preserves visually similar outputs for the same seed. The setup is small-scale and image-only, so extrapolation to large-scale language modeling should be cautious.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Lamarr Institute, University of Cologne, Reichman University, and related institutions. This reads as a training-dynamics analysis paper rather than a large-scale paradigm report from a major frontier lab.

recommendation.zh: 结论有点反常识，值得当作“替代生成范式的稳定性信号”看一眼；只读实验设定和 seed-level 对齐结果，别过度外推到 LLM。
recommendation.en: The result is mildly counter-prior and worth a look as a stability signal for alternative generative paradigms; read the setup and seed-level alignment results, but do not overgeneralize to LLMs.

institutions: Institute for AI in Medicine, UK Essen
